function searchData($findThis, $findInFields, $limit = null) {
  if (isset($findThis) && $findThis <> '' && $findThis <> null) {
    $limit = 99999;
    $searchDtl = explode("|", $findThis);
    $searchField = "";
    for ($c = 0; $c < count($searchDtl); $c++) {
      $inFileds = NULL;
      $searchField .= " and (";
      for ($x = 0; $x < count($findInFields); $x++) {
        if ($x > 0) { $inFileds .= " or "; }
        $inFileds .= " lower(" . $findInFields[$x] . ") ~~ '%" . strtolower($searchDtl[$c]) . "%' ";
      }
      $searchField .= $inFileds . ")";
    }
  } else {
    $limit = ($limit == null) ? 250 : $limit;
    $searchField = NULL;
  }
  return array("limit" => $limit, "searchSQL" => $searchField);
}

function srcDataGrid($fields, $find) {
  $rSreach = "( "; $r = 0;
  $findData = explode("%", $find);
  foreach ($findData as $s) {
    foreach ($fields as $value) {
      if ($r > 0) { $rSreach .= ' or '; }
      $rSreach .= "lower(" . $value . ") like '%" . strtolower($s) . "%'";
      $r++;
    }
  }
  $rSreach .= " )";
  return $rSreach;
}

function insertQ($table, $rows) {
    global $conn;

    $command = "INSERT INTO " . $table;
    $row = "";
    $value = "";

    foreach ($rows as $key => $values) {
        $row .= "," . $key;
        $valStr = $values ?? '';

        if (!empty($values) && is_string($valStr) && substr($valStr, 0, 8) === "currval(") {
            $value .= "," . $valStr;
        }
        else if ($values === '0' || $values === 0) {
            $value .= ",'" . $values . "'";
        }
        else if (!empty($values)) {
            $escapedVal = pg_escape_string($conn, (string)$valStr);
            $value .= ",'" . $escapedVal . "'";
        }
        else {
            $value .= ",NULL";
        }
    }

    $command .= "(" . substr($row, 1) . ")";
    $command .= " VALUES (" . substr($value, 1) . ") RETURNING id";

    return $command;
}

function updateQ($table, $data, $where = null) {
    global $conn;

    $command = "UPDATE " . $table . " SET ";
    $set = "";

    foreach ($data as $key => $values) {
        $valStr = $values ?? '';

        if ($values === '0' || $values === 0) {
            $set .= "," . $key . "='" . $values . "'";
        }
        else if (!empty($values)) {
            $escapedVal = pg_escape_string($conn, (string)$valStr);
            $set .= "," . $key . "='" . $escapedVal . "'";
        }
        else {
            $set .= "," . $key . "=NULL";
        }
    }

    $command .= substr(trim($set), 1);

    if ($where != null) {
        $command .= " WHERE " . $where;
    }

    return $command;
}
function CreateRefNo($tableName, $FieldCount, $RefInit) {
  global $conn;
  $sql = "
    (
    select CASE (count(".$FieldCount.")) WHEN 0
      THEN '".$RefInit."-".date('ym')."-00001'
      ELSE '".$RefInit."-".date('ym')."-'
        ||(select (substring('00000'||cast(CAST(max(substring(".$FieldCount." from '.....$'))AS int)+1 as varchar) from '.....$'))
        from ".$tableName."
        where substring(".$FieldCount.",length(".$FieldCount.")-9,2)='".date('y')."' and substring(".$FieldCount.",length(".$FieldCount.")-7,2)='".date('m')."')
      END  AS ref_no
    from ".$tableName." where substring(".$FieldCount.",length(".$FieldCount.")-9,2)='".date('y')."' and substring(".$FieldCount.",length(".$FieldCount.")-7,2)='".date('m')."'
    )
  ";
  $output = pg_query($conn, $sql) or die('Connection failed: ' . pg_last_error($conn));
  $AddRefNo = '';
  if (pg_num_rows($output) > 0) {
    while ($objid = pg_fetch_array($output, null, PGSQL_ASSOC)) {
      $AddRefNo = $objid["ref_no"];
    }
  }
  return $AddRefNo;
}

function CreateWHRefNo($tableName, $FieldCount, $RefInit) {
  global $conn;
  $sql = "
    (
    select CASE (count(".$FieldCount.")) WHEN 0
      THEN '".$RefInit."-".date('ym')."-00001'
      ELSE '".$RefInit."-".date('ym')."-'
        ||(select (substring('00000'||cast(CAST(max(substring(".$FieldCount." from '.....$'))AS int)+1 as varchar) from '.....$'))
        from ".$tableName."
        where substring(".$FieldCount.",0,position('-' in ".$FieldCount."))='".$RefInit."' and substring(".$FieldCount.",length(ref_no)-9,2)='".date('y')."' and substring(".$FieldCount.",length(ref_no)-7,2)='".date('m')."')
      END  AS ref_no
    from ".$tableName." where substring(".$FieldCount.",0,position('-' in ".$FieldCount."))='".$RefInit."' and substring(".$FieldCount.",length(ref_no)-9,2)='".date('y')."' and substring(".$FieldCount.",length(ref_no)-7,2)='".date('m')."'
    )
  ";
  $output = pg_query($conn, $sql) or die('Connection failed: ' . pg_last_error($conn));
  $AddRefNo = '';
  if (pg_num_rows($output) > 0) {
    while ($objid = pg_fetch_array($output, null, PGSQL_ASSOC)) {
      $AddRefNo = $objid["ref_no"];
    }
  }
  return $AddRefNo;
}

function CreateNikNo($unit, $status, $fromdate) {
  global $conn;
  $sql = "
    select (nikunitinit((select init from m_location where id in (select location_id from m_department where id=".$unit.")),(select name from m_employee_status where id=".$status."))||'".date('y',strtotime($fromdate))."'||(substring('0000'||cast((coalesce(cast(max(substring(nik::varchar(8) from '....$'))as int),0)+1) as varchar) from '....$')))::varchar(8) AS ref_no
    from m_employee
    where substring(nik::varchar(8),3,2)='".date('y',strtotime($fromdate))."'
  ";
  $output = pg_query($conn, $sql) or die('Connection failed: ' . pg_last_error($conn));
  $AddRefNo = '';
  if (pg_num_rows($output) > 0) {
    while ($objid = pg_fetch_array($output, null, PGSQL_ASSOC)) {
      $AddRefNo = $objid["ref_no"];
    }
  }
  return $AddRefNo;
}

function json2Array($jsonData) {
    global $conn;

    $jArray = json_decode(stripslashes((string)($jsonData ?? '')), true);

    if (is_array($jArray) && count($jArray) > 0) {
        $escapedItems = array();

        foreach ($jArray as $item) {
            $itemStr = (string)($item ?? '');
            $escapedItems[] = "'" . pg_escape_string($conn, $itemStr) . "'";
        }

        return implode(",", $escapedItems);
    }

    return "";
}

function String_to_float($string_obj) {
  $string = $string_obj;
  $a = explode(".", $string);
  $a2 = explode(",", $a[0]);
  $int = implode("", $a2);
  $dec = isset($a[1]) ? $a[1] : 0;
  $lengthofnum = strlen($dec);
  $divider = "1";
  $i = 0;
  while ($i < $lengthofnum) {
    $divider .= "0";
    $i++;
  }
  $divider = (int)$divider;
  return $int + ($dec / $divider);
}

function rNum($number, $round) { return floor($number / $round) * $round; }

function rAmountReport($number, $round) {
  if ($number > 0) {
    return number_format(floor($number / $round) * $round, 0, '.', ',');
  } elseif ($number < 0) {
    return number_format(floor((($number * -1) / $round) * $round) * -1, 0, '.', ',');
  } else {
    return '-';
  }
}

function Str2N($StrData) {
  return floatval(preg_replace("/[^-0-9\.]/", "", $StrData));
}

function checksinglequote($txt) {
    global $conn;
    if ($txt === null || is_bool($txt)) {
        return '';
    }
    $quotes = array("'", '"');
    return str_replace($quotes, '', pg_escape_string($conn, (string)$txt));
}

function deleteQ($table, $where = null) {
    global $conn;

    $command = "DELETE FROM " . $table;

    if ($where != null && $where !== '') {
        $command .= " WHERE " . $where;
    }

    return $command;
};

/*
  Fungsi   : DbOrFail()
  Kenapa   : crud::insert() / crud::update() / crud::delete() (di
             crudClass.php) MENANGKAP PDOException sendiri dan hanya
             `return false` -- pesan errornya tersimpan di $db->getResult(),
             TIDAK pernah dilempar ulang sebagai exception. Akibatnya kalau
             kode pemanggil tidak mengecek return value-nya secara eksplisit,
             kegagalan insert/update jadi senyap: transaksi Postgres sudah
             aborted, tapi PHP tetap lanjut ke statement berikutnya sampai
             akhirnya meledak sebagai "25P02: current transaction is aborted"
             di query lain yang sebenarnya tidak bersalah.

  Cara pakai: bungkus SETIAP panggilan $db->insert()/update()/delete() yang
  ada di dalam try/beginTransaction() dengan fungsi ini, supaya kegagalan
  langsung ketahuan & transaksi langsung rollback dengan pesan asli dari
  Postgres -- bukan pesan 25P02 yang membingungkan.

      DbOrFail($db, $db->insert('journal_entries', [...]), 'insert journal_entries');

  Throws Exception dengan pesan asli dari $db->getResult() jika $ok === false.
*/
function DbOrFail($db, $ok, $context = '') {
    if ($ok === false) {
        $raw = $db->getResult();
        $decoded = json_decode($raw, true);
        $msg = $decoded['message'] ?? $raw ?? 'Operasi database gagal (tanpa pesan detail).';
        throw new Exception(($context ? "[{$context}] " : '') . $msg);
    }
    return $ok;
}
/*
  Fungsi      : AutoPostJournal()
  Lokasi      : Tambahkan ke function.all.php (shared, dipakai lintas modul)
  Tujuan      : Generate jurnal otomatis dari modul transaksi (Sales Invoice,
                Purchase GRN, Customer Payment, dll) berdasarkan rule yang
                sudah didefinisikan di tabel fiscal_config.

  Cara pakai dari modul lain (contoh setelah simpan Sales Invoice baru):

      require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
      $result = AutoPostJournal($db, [
          'rule_code'      => 'SLSCASH',           // cocokkan ke fiscal_config.rule_code
          'reference_type' => 'sales_univoice',      // harus salah satu nilai enum reference_type
          'reference_id'   => $newInvoiceId,        // id record di tabel sumber (sales_univoices dkk)
          'journal_date'   => $univoiceDate,         // tanggal transaksi
          'amount'         => $totalAmount,         // nominal transaksi
          'description'    => 'Invoice ' . $univoiceNo
      ]);

      if (!$result['success']) {
          // tangani error -- misal rule tidak ditemukan, atau periode closed.
          // Modul pemanggil TETAP bisa lanjut simpan transaksinya (jurnal
          // gagal dibuat bukan berarti transaksi sumber harus dibatalkan --
          // itu keputusan bisnis, sesuaikan sesuai kebutuhan Anda).
      }

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UPGRADE: Override akun per transaksi (mis. Payment Entry dengan combo
  pilihan Kas/Bank dinamis dari user, bukan akun tetap dari fiscal_config).

  rule_code TETAP WAJIB diisi dan tetap divalidasi ke fiscal_config -- rule
  dipakai untuk kontrol/audit bahwa hanya kombinasi posting yang sudah
  didaftarkan yang boleh jalan, dan sebagai fallback account bila override
  tidak dikirim. Tambahkan parameter opsional:

      'debit_account_id'  => int   // override akun debit rule utk transaksi ini
      'credit_account_id' => int   // override akun kredit rule utk transaksi ini

  Contoh Payment Entry (Kas/Bank dipilih user, kredit ikut rule AR/Uang Muka):

      AutoPostJournal($db, [
          'rule_code'         => 'PAY_AR',
          'reference_type'    => 'payment_entry',
          'reference_id'      => $paymentId,
          'journal_date'      => $payDate,
          'amount'            => $allocatedTotal,
          'description'       => 'Pelunasan Invoice ' . $paymentNo,
          'debit_account_id'  => $accountId,   // akun Kas/Bank pilihan user
      ]);

  Return: ['success' => bool, 'message' => string, 'journal_id' => int|null]
*/

function AutoPostJournal($db, $params) {
    $ruleCode      = $params['rule_code'] ?? '';
    $referenceType = $params['reference_type'] ?? '';
    $referenceId   = intval($params['reference_id'] ?? 0);
    $journalDate   = $params['journal_date'] ?? date('Y-m-d');
    $amount        = Str2N($params['amount'] ?? 0);
    $description   = $params['description'] ?? '';

    // Override opsional -- kalau diisi, dipakai menggantikan akun dari rule.
    $debitAccountIdOverride  = intval($params['debit_account_id']  ?? 0);
    $creditAccountIdOverride = intval($params['credit_account_id'] ?? 0);

    if (empty($ruleCode) || empty($referenceType) || $amount <= 0) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Parameter AutoPostJournal tidak lengkap (rule_code/reference_type/amount).', 'journal_id' => null];
    }

    // 1. Cari rule di fiscal_config (tetap wajib ada & aktif, sebagai kontrol
    //    posting resmi -- walau akunnya nanti bisa di-override per transaksi)
    $stmtRule = $db->prepare("SELECT debit_account_id, credit_account_id, rule_name FROM fiscal_config WHERE rule_code = :code AND is_active = true");
    $stmtRule->execute(['code' => $ruleCode]);
    $rule = $stmtRule->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$rule) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => "Rule posting '{$ruleCode}' tidak ditemukan atau tidak aktif di fiscal_config.", 'journal_id' => null];
    }

    $debitAccountId  = $debitAccountIdOverride  > 0 ? $debitAccountIdOverride  : intval($rule['debit_account_id']);
    $creditAccountId = $creditAccountIdOverride > 0 ? $creditAccountIdOverride : intval($rule['credit_account_id']);

    if ($debitAccountId <= 0 || $creditAccountId <= 0) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => "Akun debit/kredit untuk rule '{$ruleCode}' tidak valid (cek fiscal_config atau override yang dikirim).", 'journal_id' => null];
    }

    // 2. Cari periode akuntansi berdasarkan tanggal transaksi
    $stmtPeriod = $db->prepare("
        SELECT id, is_closed FROM accounting_periods
        WHERE :jdate BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
        LIMIT 1
    ");
    $stmtPeriod->execute(['jdate' => $journalDate]);
    $period = $stmtPeriod->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$period) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => "Tidak ada periode akuntansi yang mencakup tanggal {$journalDate}. Buat periode-nya dulu di menu Fiscal Period.", 'journal_id' => null];
    }
    if ($period['is_closed']) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => "Periode akuntansi untuk tanggal {$journalDate} sudah ditutup. Jurnal otomatis tidak bisa dibuat.", 'journal_id' => null];
    }

    // 3. Buat header jurnal -- langsung status 'posted' (bukan draft), karena
    //    ini auto-generate dari transaksi yang sudah tervalidasi di modul asal.
    $refNo = CreateRefNo('journal_entries', 'ref_no', 'JV'); // JV = Journal Voucher (auto)

    try {
        DbOrFail($db, $db->insert('journal_entries', [
            'ref_no'         => $refNo,
            'journal_date'   => $journalDate,
            'period_id'      => $period['id'],
            'reference_type' => $referenceType,
            'reference_id'   => $referenceId,
            'description'    => $description ?: $rule['rule_name'],
            'status'         => 'posted',
            'posted_by'      => $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? null,
            'posted_at'      => date('Y-m-d H:i:s')
        ]), 'insert journal_entries');

        $stmtNewId = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM journal_entries WHERE ref_no = :no");
        $stmtNewId->execute(['no' => $refNo]);
        $journalId = $stmtNewId->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['id'] ?? null;

        if (!$journalId) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Gagal membuat header jurnal.', 'journal_id' => null];
        }

        // 4. Insert 2 baris (debit & kredit) -- pakai akun hasil override jika ada
        DbOrFail($db, $db->insert('journal_lines', [
            'journal_id'  => $journalId,
            'account_id'  => $debitAccountId,
            'debit'       => $amount,
            'credit'      => 0,
            'description' => $description
        ]), 'insert journal_lines (debit)');

        DbOrFail($db, $db->insert('journal_lines', [
            'journal_id'  => $journalId,
            'account_id'  => $creditAccountId,
            'debit'       => 0,
            'credit'      => $amount,
            'description' => $description
        ]), 'insert journal_lines (credit)');

    } catch (Exception $e) {
        // Pesan asli dari Postgres (mis. constraint reference_type/status,
        // FK period_id/account_id tidak valid, dsb) dikembalikan ke pemanggil
        // -- bukan dibiarkan jadi 25P02 senyap di query lain.
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage(), 'journal_id' => null];
    }

    return ['success' => true, 'message' => "Jurnal otomatis {$refNo} berhasil dibuat.", 'journal_id' => $journalId];
}

/*
  Fungsi   : ReverseJournalByReference()
  Tujuan   : Hapus semua jurnal (header + lines) yang tercatat untuk sebuah
             reference_type + reference_id tertentu. Dipakai saat modul
             sumber (Payment Entry, Sales Invoice, dll) di-update atau
             dihapus, sebelum AutoPostJournal() dipanggil ulang.

  Catatan  : Satu reference_type+reference_id bisa punya LEBIH DARI SATU
             journal_entries (mis. Payment Entry dengan alokasi Piutang +
             Uang Muka = 2 kali panggil AutoPostJournal = 2 journal_entries).
             Fungsi ini menghapus semuanya sekaligus.

  Return: int  -> jumlah journal_entries yang dihapus
*/
function ReverseJournalByReference($db, $referenceType, $referenceId) {
    $referenceId = intval($referenceId);
    if (empty($referenceType) || $referenceId <= 0) {
        return 0;
    }

    $stmtFind = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM journal_entries WHERE reference_type = :rtype AND reference_id = :rid");
    $stmtFind->execute(['rtype' => $referenceType, 'rid' => $referenceId]);
    $journalIds = $stmtFind->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);

    if (!$journalIds) {
        return 0;
    }

    $stmtDelLines  = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_id = :jid");
    $stmtDelHeader = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM journal_entries WHERE id = :jid");

    foreach ($journalIds as $jid) {
        $stmtDelLines->execute(['jid' => $jid]);
        $stmtDelHeader->execute(['jid' => $jid]);
    }

    return count($journalIds);
}

<?php
define('BASE_PATH', '/var/www/html/proyek');
if (session_status() == PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}
// 1. Include Dependensi Utama
include_once __DIR__ . "/../php-func/function.all.php";
include_once __DIR__ . "/../php-class/crudClass.php";

// Resolve Nama File dari URI saat ini
$url_text = parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'], PHP_URL_PATH);
$file = explode("/", $url_text);
$url_file = end($file); // Mengambil nama file paling akhir (misal: m.gemstone.php / m.gemstoneCRD.php)

// Resolver Koneksi Database Global
global $conn, $dbconn;
if (!isset($conn) || !$conn) {
    if (isset($dbconn) && $dbconn) {
        $conn = $dbconn;
    } elseif (isset($GLOBALS['dbconn'])) {
        $conn = $GLOBALS['dbconn'];
    } elseif (isset($GLOBALS['conn'])) {
        $conn = $GLOBALS['conn'];
    }
}

// Validasi Koneksi DB
if (!$conn) {
    die("Error Fatal: Variabel koneksi DB (\$conn) bernilai NULL di user.valid.php.");
}

// 2. Redirect jika User Belum Login
if (!isset($_SESSION['user_id']) || is_null($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
    if (!empty($_SERVER['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH']) && strtolower($_SERVER['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH']) == 'xmlhttprequest') {
        http_response_code(401);
        echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Session telah berakhir. Silakan login kembali."]);
        exit;
    } else {
        header('Location: ../index.php');
        exit;
    }
}

$userId = $_SESSION["user_id"];

// 3. Tangkap Form/Menu ID dari Query Parameter (jika ada)
$formId = null;
if (isset($_REQUEST['menu_id']) && !empty($_REQUEST['menu_id'])) {
    $formId = intval($_REQUEST['menu_id']);
} elseif (isset($_REQUEST['form_id']) && !empty($_REQUEST['form_id'])) {
    $formId = intval($_REQUEST['form_id']);
} elseif (isset($_GET['id']) && !empty($_GET['id']) && !isset($_POST['task'])) {
    // Hanya tangkap ?id= dari GET jika bukan request POST CRUD
    $formId = intval($_GET['id']);
} elseif (isset($_SESSION['form_id'])) {
    $formId = intval($_SESSION['form_id']);
}

// 4. Resolve Access Level dari Database
$formAccess = null;

if (!is_null($formId) && $formId > 0) {
    // Jika $formId diketahui, Query berdasarkan user_id & form_id
    $sql = "SELECT access_level FROM m_user_access_menu WHERE user_id = $1 AND form_id = $2";
    $output = pg_query_params($conn, $sql, array($userId, $formId));
    if ($output && pg_num_rows($output) > 0) {
        $objid = pg_fetch_array($output, null, PGSQL_ASSOC);
        $formAccess = $objid["access_level"];
    }
}

            FROM m_user_access_menu a

        $formAccess = $objid["access_level"];
        if (is_null($formId) || $formId <= 0) {
            $formId = intval($objid["real_form_id"]);
        }
    }

           FROM m_form_group d
           LEFT JOIN (

           ) h ON SUBSTRING(h.seq, 1, 2) = SUBSTRING(d.seq, 1, 2)
           WHERE SUBSTRING(d.seq, 3, 2) <> '00' AND SUBSTRING(d.seq, 1, 2) <> '00')
          UNION
          (SELECT h.id, h.name, h.remark, seq
           FROM m_form_group h
           WHERE SUBSTRING(seq, 3, 2) = '00' AND SUBSTRING(seq, 1, 2) <> '00')
        ) data
        ORDER BY seq
      ) g ON g.id = f.group_id
      WHERE l.form_id = $1
      ORDER BY g.seq, f.title";

        $cGroup = '';

                if ($cGroup == '') {
                    $linkMenu .= '<div id="groupMenu">' . htmlspecialchars($objid["name"]) . '</div>';
                    $linkMenu .= '<div class="Hline-separatorMid"></div>';

                    $linkMenu .= '<div class="Hline-separatorMid"></div>';

                $linkMenu .= '<a href="' . htmlspecialchars($targetUrl) . '" target="_blank">' . htmlspecialchars($objid["title"]) . '</a>';
                $cGroup = $objid["seq"];
            }
            $_SESSION["linkMenu"] = $linkMenu;
        }
    }
}

function searchData($findThis, $findInFields, $limit = null) {
  if (isset($findThis) && $findThis <> '' && $findThis <> null) {
    $limit = 99999;
    $searchDtl = explode("|", $findThis);
    $searchField = "";
    for ($c = 0; $c < count($searchDtl); $c++) {
      $inFileds = NULL;
      $searchField .= " and (";
      for ($x = 0; $x < count($findInFields); $x++) {
        if ($x > 0) { $inFileds .= " or "; }
        $inFileds .= " lower(" . $findInFields[$x] . ") ~~ '%" . strtolower($searchDtl[$c]) . "%' ";
      }
      $searchField .= $inFileds . ")";
    }
  } else {
    $limit = ($limit == null) ? 250 : $limit;
    $searchField = NULL;
  }
  return array("limit" => $limit, "searchSQL" => $searchField);
}

function srcDataGrid($fields, $find) {
  $rSreach = "( "; $r = 0;
  $findData = explode("%", $find);
  foreach ($findData as $s) {
    foreach ($fields as $value) {
      if ($r > 0) { $rSreach .= ' or '; }
      $rSreach .= "lower(" . $value . ") like '%" . strtolower($s) . "%'";
      $r++;
    }
  }
  $rSreach .= " )";
  return $rSreach;
}

function insertQ($table, $rows) {
    global $conn;

    $command = "INSERT INTO " . $table;
    $row = "";
    $value = "";

    foreach ($rows as $key => $values) {
        $row .= "," . $key;
        $valStr = $values ?? '';

        if (!empty($values) && is_string($valStr) && substr($valStr, 0, 8) === "currval(") {
            $value .= "," . $valStr;
        }
        else if ($values === '0' || $values === 0) {
            $value .= ",'" . $values . "'";
        }
        else if (!empty($values)) {
            $escapedVal = pg_escape_string($conn, (string)$valStr);
            $value .= ",'" . $escapedVal . "'";
        }
        else {
            $value .= ",NULL";
        }
    }

    $command .= "(" . substr($row, 1) . ")";
    $command .= " VALUES (" . substr($value, 1) . ") RETURNING id";

    return $command;
}

function updateQ($table, $data, $where = null) {
    global $conn;

    $command = "UPDATE " . $table . " SET ";
    $set = "";

    foreach ($data as $key => $values) {
        $valStr = $values ?? '';

        if ($values === '0' || $values === 0) {
            $set .= "," . $key . "='" . $values . "'";
        }
        else if (!empty($values)) {
            $escapedVal = pg_escape_string($conn, (string)$valStr);
            $set .= "," . $key . "='" . $escapedVal . "'";
        }
        else {
            $set .= "," . $key . "=NULL";
        }
    }

    $command .= substr(trim($set), 1);

    if ($where != null) {
        $command .= " WHERE " . $where;
    }

    return $command;
}
function CreateRefNo($tableName, $FieldCount, $RefInit) {
  global $conn;
  $sql = "
    (
    select CASE (count(".$FieldCount.")) WHEN 0
      THEN '".$RefInit."-".date('ym')."-00001'
      ELSE '".$RefInit."-".date('ym')."-'
        ||(select (substring('00000'||cast(CAST(max(substring(".$FieldCount." from '.....$'))AS int)+1 as varchar) from '.....$'))
        from ".$tableName."
        where substring(".$FieldCount.",length(".$FieldCount.")-9,2)='".date('y')."' and substring(".$FieldCount.",length(".$FieldCount.")-7,2)='".date('m')."')
      END  AS ref_no
    from ".$tableName." where substring(".$FieldCount.",length(".$FieldCount.")-9,2)='".date('y')."' and substring(".$FieldCount.",length(".$FieldCount.")-7,2)='".date('m')."'
    )
  ";
  $output = pg_query($conn, $sql) or die('Connection failed: ' . pg_last_error($conn));
  $AddRefNo = '';
  if (pg_num_rows($output) > 0) {
    while ($objid = pg_fetch_array($output, null, PGSQL_ASSOC)) {
      $AddRefNo = $objid["ref_no"];
    }
  }
  return $AddRefNo;
}

function json2Array($jsonData) {
    global $conn;

    $jArray = json_decode(stripslashes((string)($jsonData ?? '')), true);

    if (is_array($jArray) && count($jArray) > 0) {
        $escapedItems = array();

        foreach ($jArray as $item) {
            $itemStr = (string)($item ?? '');
            $escapedItems[] = "'" . pg_escape_string($conn, $itemStr) . "'";
        }

        return implode(",", $escapedItems);
    }

    return "";
}

function String_to_float($string_obj) {
  $string = $string_obj;
  $a = explode(".", $string);
  $a2 = explode(",", $a[0]);
  $int = implode("", $a2);
  $dec = isset($a[1]) ? $a[1] : 0;
  $lengthofnum = strlen($dec);
  $divider = "1";
  $i = 0;
  while ($i < $lengthofnum) {
    $divider .= "0";
    $i++;
  }
  $divider = (int)$divider;
  return $int + ($dec / $divider);
}

function rAmountReport($number, $round) {
  if ($number > 0) {
    return number_format(floor($number / $round) * $round, 0, '.', ',');
  } elseif ($number < 0) {
    return number_format(floor((($number * -1) / $round) * $round) * -1, 0, '.', ',');
  } else {
    return '-';
  }
}

function checksinglequote($txt) {
    global $conn;
    if ($txt === null || is_bool($txt)) {

/*
  Fungsi   : DbOrFail()
  Kenapa   : crud::insert() / crud::update() / crud::delete() (di
             crudClass.php) MENANGKAP PDOException sendiri dan hanya
             `return false` -- pesan errornya tersimpan di $db->getResult(),
             TIDAK pernah dilempar ulang sebagai exception. Akibatnya kalau
             kode pemanggil tidak mengecek return value-nya secara eksplisit,
             kegagalan insert/update jadi senyap: transaksi Postgres sudah
             aborted, tapi PHP tetap lanjut ke statement berikutnya sampai
             akhirnya meledak sebagai "25P02: current transaction is aborted"
             di query lain yang sebenarnya tidak bersalah.

  Cara pakai: bungkus SETIAP panggilan $db->insert()/update()/delete() yang
  ada di dalam try/beginTransaction() dengan fungsi ini, supaya kegagalan
  langsung ketahuan & transaksi langsung rollback dengan pesan asli dari
  Postgres -- bukan pesan 25P02 yang membingungkan.

      DbOrFail($db, $db->insert('journal_entries', [...]), 'insert journal_entries');

  Throws Exception dengan pesan asli dari $db->getResult() jika $ok === false.
*/
function DbOrFail($db, $ok, $context = '') {
    if ($ok === false) {
        $raw = $db->getResult();
        $decoded = json_decode($raw, true);
        $msg = $decoded['message'] ?? $raw ?? 'Operasi database gagal (tanpa pesan detail).';
        throw new Exception(($context ? "[{$context}] " : '') . $msg);
    }
    return $ok;
}
/*
  Fungsi      : AutoPostJournal()
  Lokasi      : Tambahkan ke function.all.php (shared, dipakai lintas modul)
  Tujuan      : Generate jurnal otomatis dari modul transaksi (Sales Invoice,
                Purchase GRN, Customer Payment, dll) berdasarkan rule yang
                sudah didefinisikan di tabel fiscal_config.

  Cara pakai dari modul lain (contoh setelah simpan Sales Invoice baru):

      require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
      $result = AutoPostJournal($db, [
          'rule_code'      => 'SLSCASH',           // cocokkan ke fiscal_config.rule_code
          'reference_type' => 'sales_univoice',      // harus salah satu nilai enum reference_type
          'reference_id'   => $newInvoiceId,        // id record di tabel sumber (sales_univoices dkk)
          'journal_date'   => $univoiceDate,         // tanggal transaksi
          'amount'         => $totalAmount,         // nominal transaksi
          'description'    => 'Invoice ' . $univoiceNo
      ]);

      if (!$result['success']) {
          // tangani error -- misal rule tidak ditemukan, atau periode closed.
          // Modul pemanggil TETAP bisa lanjut simpan transaksinya (jurnal
          // gagal dibuat bukan berarti transaksi sumber harus dibatalkan --
          // itu keputusan bisnis, sesuaikan sesuai kebutuhan Anda).
      }

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UPGRADE: Override akun per transaksi (mis. Payment Entry dengan combo
  pilihan Kas/Bank dinamis dari user, bukan akun tetap dari fiscal_config).

  rule_code TETAP WAJIB diisi dan tetap divalidasi ke fiscal_config -- rule
  dipakai untuk kontrol/audit bahwa hanya kombinasi posting yang sudah
  didaftarkan yang boleh jalan, dan sebagai fallback account bila override
  tidak dikirim. Tambahkan parameter opsional:

      'debit_account_id'  => int   // override akun debit rule utk transaksi ini
      'credit_account_id' => int   // override akun kredit rule utk transaksi ini

  Contoh Payment Entry (Kas/Bank dipilih user, kredit ikut rule AR/Uang Muka):

      AutoPostJournal($db, [
          'rule_code'         => 'PAY_AR',
          'reference_type'    => 'payment_entry',
          'reference_id'      => $paymentId,
          'journal_date'      => $payDate,
          'amount'            => $allocatedTotal,
          'description'       => 'Pelunasan Invoice ' . $paymentNo,
          'debit_account_id'  => $accountId,   // akun Kas/Bank pilihan user
      ]);

  Return: ['success' => bool, 'message' => string, 'journal_id' => int|null]
*/

function AutoPostJournal($db, $params) {
    $ruleCode      = $params['rule_code'] ?? '';
    $referenceType = $params['reference_type'] ?? '';
    $referenceId   = intval($params['reference_id'] ?? 0);
    $journalDate   = $params['journal_date'] ?? date('Y-m-d');
    $amount        = Str2N($params['amount'] ?? 0);
    $description   = $params['description'] ?? '';

    // Override opsional -- kalau diisi, dipakai menggantikan akun dari rule.
    $debitAccountIdOverride  = intval($params['debit_account_id']  ?? 0);
    $creditAccountIdOverride = intval($params['credit_account_id'] ?? 0);

    if (empty($ruleCode) || empty($referenceType) || $amount <= 0) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Parameter AutoPostJournal tidak lengkap (rule_code/reference_type/amount).', 'journal_id' => null];
    }

    // 1. Cari rule di fiscal_config (tetap wajib ada & aktif, sebagai kontrol
    //    posting resmi -- walau akunnya nanti bisa di-override per transaksi)
    $stmtRule = $db->prepare("SELECT debit_account_id, credit_account_id, rule_name FROM fiscal_config WHERE rule_code = :code AND is_active = true");
    $stmtRule->execute(['code' => $ruleCode]);
    $rule = $stmtRule->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$rule) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => "Rule posting '{$ruleCode}' tidak ditemukan atau tidak aktif di fiscal_config.", 'journal_id' => null];
    }

    $debitAccountId  = $debitAccountIdOverride  > 0 ? $debitAccountIdOverride  : intval($rule['debit_account_id']);
    $creditAccountId = $creditAccountIdOverride > 0 ? $creditAccountIdOverride : intval($rule['credit_account_id']);

    if ($debitAccountId <= 0 || $creditAccountId <= 0) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => "Akun debit/kredit untuk rule '{$ruleCode}' tidak valid (cek fiscal_config atau override yang dikirim).", 'journal_id' => null];
    }

    // 2. Cari periode akuntansi berdasarkan tanggal transaksi
    $stmtPeriod = $db->prepare("
        SELECT id, is_closed FROM accounting_periods
        WHERE :jdate BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
        LIMIT 1
    ");
    $stmtPeriod->execute(['jdate' => $journalDate]);
    $period = $stmtPeriod->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$period) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => "Tidak ada periode akuntansi yang mencakup tanggal {$journalDate}. Buat periode-nya dulu di menu Fiscal Period.", 'journal_id' => null];
    }
    if ($period['is_closed']) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => "Periode akuntansi untuk tanggal {$journalDate} sudah ditutup. Jurnal otomatis tidak bisa dibuat.", 'journal_id' => null];
    }

    // 3. Buat header jurnal -- langsung status 'posted' (bukan draft), karena
    //    ini auto-generate dari transaksi yang sudah tervalidasi di modul asal.
    $refNo = CreateRefNo('journal_entries', 'ref_no', 'JV'); // JV = Journal Voucher (auto)

    try {
        DbOrFail($db, $db->insert('journal_entries', [
            'ref_no'         => $refNo,
            'journal_date'   => $journalDate,
            'period_id'      => $period['id'],
            'reference_type' => $referenceType,
            'reference_id'   => $referenceId,
            'description'    => $description ?: $rule['rule_name'],
            'status'         => 'posted',
            'posted_by'      => $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? null,
            'posted_at'      => date('Y-m-d H:i:s')
        ]), 'insert journal_entries');

        $stmtNewId = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM journal_entries WHERE ref_no = :no");
        $stmtNewId->execute(['no' => $refNo]);
        $journalId = $stmtNewId->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['id'] ?? null;

        if (!$journalId) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Gagal membuat header jurnal.', 'journal_id' => null];
        }

        // 4. Insert 2 baris (debit & kredit) -- pakai akun hasil override jika ada
        DbOrFail($db, $db->insert('journal_lines', [
            'journal_id'  => $journalId,
            'account_id'  => $debitAccountId,
            'debit'       => $amount,
            'credit'      => 0,
            'description' => $description
        ]), 'insert journal_lines (debit)');

        DbOrFail($db, $db->insert('journal_lines', [
            'journal_id'  => $journalId,
            'account_id'  => $creditAccountId,
            'debit'       => 0,
            'credit'      => $amount,
            'description' => $description
        ]), 'insert journal_lines (credit)');

    } catch (Exception $e) {
        // Pesan asli dari Postgres (mis. constraint reference_type/status,
        // FK period_id/account_id tidak valid, dsb) dikembalikan ke pemanggil
        // -- bukan dibiarkan jadi 25P02 senyap di query lain.
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage(), 'journal_id' => null];
    }

    return ['success' => true, 'message' => "Jurnal otomatis {$refNo} berhasil dibuat.", 'journal_id' => $journalId];
}

/*
  Fungsi   : ReverseJournalByReference()
  Tujuan   : Hapus semua jurnal (header + lines) yang tercatat untuk sebuah
             reference_type + reference_id tertentu. Dipakai saat modul
             sumber (Payment Entry, Sales Invoice, dll) di-update atau
             dihapus, sebelum AutoPostJournal() dipanggil ulang.

  Catatan  : Satu reference_type+reference_id bisa punya LEBIH DARI SATU
             journal_entries (mis. Payment Entry dengan alokasi Piutang +
             Uang Muka = 2 kali panggil AutoPostJournal = 2 journal_entries).
             Fungsi ini menghapus semuanya sekaligus.

  Return: int  -> jumlah journal_entries yang dihapus
*/
function ReverseJournalByReference($db, $referenceType, $referenceId) {
    $referenceId = intval($referenceId);
    if (empty($referenceType) || $referenceId <= 0) {
        return 0;
    }

    $stmtFind = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM journal_entries WHERE reference_type = :rtype AND reference_id = :rid");
    $stmtFind->execute(['rtype' => $referenceType, 'rid' => $referenceId]);
    $journalIds = $stmtFind->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);

    if (!$journalIds) {
        return 0;
    }

    $stmtDelLines  = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_id = :jid");
    $stmtDelHeader = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM journal_entries WHERE id = :jid");

    foreach ($journalIds as $jid) {
        $stmtDelLines->execute(['jid' => $jid]);
        $stmtDelHeader->execute(['jid' => $jid]);
    }

    return count($journalIds);
}

/*
  Fungsi   : PostStockMovement()
  Tujuan   : Catat 1 baris pergerakan stok (IN atau OUT) ke ledger
             stock_movements. Dipakai oleh GRN (IN), Sales Delivery (OUT),
             Stock Transfer (IN+OUT sepasang), Purchase/Sales Return, dll.

  $params = [
      'movement_date'  => 'YYYY-MM-DD',  (required)
      'item_id'        => int,            (required)
      'grade_id'       => int|null,
      'warehouse_id'   => int,            (required)
      'movement_type'  => 'IN'|'OUT',     (required)
      'qty'            => float,          (required, > 0)
      'unit_cost'      => float,          (optional, default 0)
      'reference_type' => string,         (required)
      'reference_id'   => int,            (required)
      'reference_no'   => string,         (optional, buat tampilan cepat)
      'remark'         => string,
  ]

  Return: int  -> id baris stock_movements yang baru diinsert
  Throws Exception kalau parameter wajib kosong / movement_type tidak valid.
*/
function PostStockMovement($db, $params) {
    $movementDate  = $params['movement_date'] ?? null;
    $itemId        = intval($params['item_id'] ?? 0);
    $gradeId       = isset($params['grade_id']) && $params['grade_id'] !== '' ? intval($params['grade_id']) : null;
    $warehouseId   = intval($params['warehouse_id'] ?? 0);
    $movementType  = strtoupper($params['movement_type'] ?? '');
    $qty           = round(floatval($params['qty'] ?? 0), 4);
    $unitCost      = round(floatval($params['unit_cost'] ?? 0), 4);
    $referenceType = $params['reference_type'] ?? '';
    $referenceId   = intval($params['reference_id'] ?? 0);
    $referenceNo   = $params['reference_no'] ?? null;
    $remark        = $params['remark'] ?? null;

    if (empty($movementDate) || $itemId <= 0 || $warehouseId <= 0 || $qty <= 0) {
        throw new Exception("Parameter PostStockMovement tidak lengkap (movement_date/item_id/warehouse_id/qty wajib diisi & valid).");
    }
    if (!in_array($movementType, ['IN', 'OUT'], true)) {
        throw new Exception("movement_type harus 'IN' atau 'OUT', diterima: '{$movementType}'.");
    }
    if (empty($referenceType) || $referenceId <= 0) {
        throw new Exception("Parameter PostStockMovement tidak lengkap (reference_type/reference_id wajib diisi).");
    }

    $ok = $db->insert('stock_movements', [
        'movement_date'  => $movementDate,
        'item_id'        => $itemId,
        'grade_id'       => $gradeId,
        'warehouse_id'   => $warehouseId,
        'movement_type'  => $movementType,
        'qty'            => $qty,
        'unit_cost'      => $unitCost,
        'reference_type' => $referenceType,
        'reference_id'   => $referenceId,
        'reference_no'   => $referenceNo,
        'remark'         => $remark,
        'created_by'     => $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? null
    ]);

    if ($ok === false) {
        throw new Exception("Gagal insert stock_movements: " . $db->getResult());
    }

    return $db->lastInsertId();
}

/*
  Fungsi   : ReverseStockMovementByReference()
  Tujuan   : Hapus semua baris stock_movements untuk reference_type +
             reference_id tertentu. Dipakai saat modul sumber (GRN, Sales
             Delivery, dll) di-update atau dihapus, sebelum
             PostStockMovement() dipanggil ulang.

  Return: int -> jumlah baris yang dihapus
*/
function ReverseStockMovementByReference($db, $referenceType, $referenceId) {
    $referenceId = intval($referenceId);
    if (empty($referenceType) || $referenceId <= 0) {
        return 0;
    }

    $stmtCount = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_movements WHERE reference_type = :rtype AND reference_id = :rid");
    $stmtCount->execute(['rtype' => $referenceType, 'rid' => $referenceId]);
    $count = intval($stmtCount->fetchColumn());

    if ($count > 0) {
        $stmtDel = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_movements WHERE reference_type = :rtype AND reference_id = :rid");
        $stmtDel->execute(['rtype' => $referenceType, 'rid' => $referenceId]);
    }

    return $count;
}

/*
  Fungsi   : GetStockBalance()
  Tujuan   : Ambil saldo stok saat ini untuk 1 item (+grade opsional) di
             1 gudang tertentu, langsung dari view_stock_balance.
*/
function GetStockBalance($db, $itemId, $gradeId, $warehouseId) {
    if ($gradeId) {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT balance_qty FROM view_stock_balance WHERE item_id = :item_id AND grade_id = :grade_id AND warehouse_id = :warehouse_id");
        $stmt->execute(['item_id' => $itemId, 'grade_id' => $gradeId, 'warehouse_id' => $warehouseId]);
    } else {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT balance_qty FROM view_stock_balance WHERE item_id = :item_id AND grade_id IS NULL AND warehouse_id = :warehouse_id");
        $stmt->execute(['item_id' => $itemId, 'warehouse_id' => $warehouseId]);
    }
    $balance = $stmt->fetchColumn();
    return $balance !== false ? round(floatval($balance), 4) : 0.0;
}



?><?php
/**
 * GANTI RecalcGrnStatus() yang sudah ada di function.all.php dengan ini.
 * Perbaikan: DbOrFail($result,'msg') dihapus -- itu salah pakai (DbOrFail
 * asli butuh $db + boolean, bukan pg_query_params() resource). Native
 * pg_query_params() dicek manual di sini.
 */
function RecalcGrnStatus($grn_hdr_id) {
    $sql = "SELECT
                COUNT(*) AS total_items,
                SUM(CASE WHEN (gd.qty_received - COALESCE(wd.qty_wh_sum,0)) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fully_received,
                SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(wd.qty_wh_sum,0) > 0
                          AND (gd.qty_received - COALESCE(wd.qty_wh_sum,0)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partially_received
            FROM grn_dtl gd
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT d.grn_dtl_id, SUM(d.qty_received) AS qty_wh_sum
                FROM wh_receiving_dtl d
                JOIN wh_receiving_hdr h ON h.id = d.wh_receiving_hdr_id AND h.status = 'posted'
                GROUP BY d.grn_dtl_id
            ) wd ON wd.grn_dtl_id = gd.id
            WHERE gd.grn_hdr_id = $1";
    $result = pg_query_params($sql, [$grn_hdr_id]);
    if ($result === false) {
        throw new Exception('[RecalcGrnStatus] ' . pg_last_error());
    }
    $row = pg_fetch_assoc($result);

    if ((int)$row['total_items'] === 0) {
        $status = 'open';
    } elseif ((int)$row['fully_received'] === (int)$row['total_items']) {
        $status = 'closed';
    } elseif ((int)$row['fully_received'] > 0 || (int)$row['partially_received'] > 0) {
        $status = 'partial';
    } else {
        $status = 'open';
    }

    $upd = pg_query_params("UPDATE grn_hdr SET status = $1 WHERE id = $2", [$status, $grn_hdr_id]);
    if ($upd === false) {
        throw new Exception('[RecalcGrnStatus update] ' . pg_last_error());
    }

    return $status;
}

<?php
/**
 * Cron Task / Scraper: fetch_kurs_pajak.php
 * Mengambil data Kurs Pajak mingguan dari Kemenkeu (https://fiskal.kemenkeu.go.id/informasi-publik/kurs-pajak)
 * dan menyimpannya secara otomatis ke database lokal proyekgmn (tax_exchange_rate_hdr & dtl).
 *
 * Jalankan via CLI / Cron setiap hari Rabu:
 * 0 8 * * 3 php /home/myadmin/proyekgmn/cron/fetch_kurs_pajak.php
 */

//chdir(__DIR__ . '/..');
//require_once 'php-crud/db_connection.PHP';

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

function parseIndonesianDate($dateStr) {
    $months = [
        'Januari' => '01', 'Februari' => '02', 'Maret' => '03', 'April' => '04',
        'Mei' => '05', 'Juni' => '06', 'Juli' => '07', 'Agustus' => '08',
        'September' => '09', 'Oktober' => '10', 'November' => '11', 'Desember' => '12',
        'Jan' => '01', 'Feb' => '02', 'Mar' => '03', 'Apr' => '04',
        'Mei' => '05', 'Jun' => '06', 'Jul' => '07', 'Agt' => '08',
        'Sep' => '09', 'Okt' => '10', 'Nov' => '11', 'Des' => '12'
    ];

    $parts = preg_split('/\s+/', trim($dateStr));
    if (count($parts) >= 3) {
        $day = str_pad($parts[0], 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
        $month = $months[$parts[1]] ?? '01';
        $year = $parts[2];
        return "$year-$month-$day";
    }
    return date('Y-m-d');
}

function fetchAndStoreTaxExchangeRates($pdo) {
    $url = "https://fiskal.kemenkeu.go.id/informasi-publik/kurs-pajak";

    $html = false;
    if (function_exists('curl_init')) {
        $ch = curl_init();
        curl_setopt_array($ch, [
            CURLOPT_URL => $url,
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_USERAGENT => 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 30,
            CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER => false
        ]);
        $html = curl_exec($ch);
        curl_close($ch);
    }

    if ($html === false || empty($html)) {
        $opts = [
            'http' => [
                'method' => 'GET',
                'header' => "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36\r\n"
            ],
            'ssl' => [
                'verify_peer' => false,
                'verify_peer_name' => false
            ]
        ];
        $context = stream_context_create($opts);
        $html = @file_get_contents($url, false, $context);
    }

    if (empty($html)) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => "Gagal mengambil HTML dari $url"];
    }

    // 1. Extract KMK No
    $kmkNo = 'KMK Kurs Pajak';
    if (preg_match('/KMK\s+Nomor\s+([^\<]+)/i', $html, $matches)) {
        $kmkNo = trim($matches[1]);
    }

    // 2. Extract Tanggal Berlaku (Start Date & End Date)
    $startDate = date('Y-m-d');
    $endDate = date('Y-m-d', strtotime('+6 days'));
    if (preg_match('/Tanggal\s+berlaku:\s*(\d+\s+[A-Za-z]+\s+\d{4})\s*-\s*(\d+\s+[A-Za-z]+\s+\d{4})/i', $html, $matches)) {
        $startDate = parseIndonesianDate($matches[1]);
        $endDate = parseIndonesianDate($matches[2]);
    }

    // 3. Extract File URL salinan KMK
    $fileUrl = null;
    if (preg_match('/<a[^>]+class=["\']view-pdf["\'][^>]+href=["\']([^"\']+)["\']/i', $html, $matches)) {
        $fileUrl = "https://fiskal.kemenkeu.go.id" . $matches[1];
    }

    // Cek apakah periode ini sudah tersimpan di DB
    $stmtCheck = $pdo->prepare("SELECT id FROM tax_exchange_rate_hdr WHERE start_date = :start_date AND end_date = :end_date");
    $stmtCheck->execute(['start_date' => $startDate, 'end_date' => $endDate]);
    $existingHdr = $stmtCheck->fetch();

    if ($existingHdr) {
        $hdrId = $existingHdr['id'];
        $stmtUpdateHdr = $pdo->prepare("UPDATE tax_exchange_rate_hdr SET kmk_no = :kmk_no, file_url = :file_url WHERE id = :id");
        $stmtUpdateHdr->execute(['kmk_no' => $kmkNo, 'file_url' => $fileUrl, 'id' => $hdrId]);

        $pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM tax_exchange_rate_dtl WHERE hdr_id = :hdr_id")->execute(['hdr_id' => $hdrId]);
    } else {
        $stmtInsHdr = $pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO tax_exchange_rate_hdr (kmk_no, start_date, end_date, file_url, remark) VALUES (:kmk_no, :start_date, :end_date, :file_url, 'Auto-synced via Kemenkeu') RETURNING id");
        $stmtInsHdr->execute([
            'kmk_no' => $kmkNo,
            'start_date' => $startDate,
            'end_date' => $endDate,
            'file_url' => $fileUrl
        ]);
        $hdrId = $stmtInsHdr->fetchColumn();
    }

    // Load m_currency map (Code -> ID)
    $currMap = [];
    $stmtCurr = $pdo->query("SELECT id, UPPER(TRIM(init)) AS code FROM m_currency WHERE init IS NOT NULL AND init != ''");
    while ($row = $stmtCurr->fetch()) {
        $currMap[$row['code']] = $row['id'];
    }

    // 4. Parse Table Rows
    preg_match_all('/<tr[^>]*>(.*?)<\/tr>/s', $html, $trMatches);
    $insertedCount = 0;

    $stmtInsDtl = $pdo->prepare("
        INSERT INTO tax_exchange_rate_dtl 
        (hdr_id, currency_id, currency_code, currency_name, unit_multiplier, rate, rate_per_unit, prev_rate, change_amount, change_direction) 
        VALUES 
        (:hdr_id, :currency_id, :currency_code, :currency_name, :unit_multiplier, :rate, :rate_per_unit, :prev_rate, :change_amount, :change_direction)
    ");

    foreach ($trMatches[1] as $trHtml) {
        if (strpos($trHtml, '<th') !== false || strpos($trHtml, 'Mata Uang') !== false) {
            continue;
        }

        $currencyCode = '';
        $currencyName = '';

        if (preg_match('/<span[^>]*class=[\'"]hidden-xs[\'"][^>]*>\s*([^\<\)]+)\s*\(([A-Z]{3})\)\s*<\/span>/i', $trHtml, $mCurr)) {
            $currencyName = trim($mCurr[1]);
            $currencyCode = trim($mCurr[2]);
        } elseif (preg_match('/([A-Z]{3})/', $trHtml, $mCode)) {
            $currencyCode = trim($mCode[1]);
            $currencyName = $currencyCode;
        }

        if (empty($currencyCode)) continue;

        $rate = 0.0;
        if (preg_match('/<div[^>]*class=[\'"][^\'"]*m-l-5[^\'"]*[\'"][^>]*>\s*([\d\.,]+)\s*<\/div>/i', $trHtml, $mRate)) {
            $rateStr = str_replace('.', '', $mRate[1]);
            $rateStr = str_replace(',', '.', $rateStr);
            $rate = floatval($rateStr);
        }

        if ($rate <= 0) continue;

        $changeAmount = 0.0;
        $direction = 'FLAT';

        if (strpos($trHtml, 'curr-up') !== false) {
            $direction = 'UP';
        } elseif (strpos($trHtml, 'curr-down') !== false) {
            $direction = 'DOWN';
        }

        if (preg_match('/td[^>]*curr-change[^>]*>\s*([\d\.,]+)/i', $trHtml, $mChange)) {
            $changeStr = str_replace('.', '', $mChange[1]);
            $changeStr = str_replace(',', '.', $changeStr);
            $changeAmount = floatval($changeStr);
        }

        $multiplier = ($currencyCode === 'JPY') ? 100.0 : 1.0;
        $ratePerUnit = $rate / $multiplier;
        $currencyId = $currMap[$currencyCode] ?? null;

        $prevRate = 0.0;
        if ($direction === 'UP') {
            $prevRate = $rate - $changeAmount;
        } elseif ($direction === 'DOWN') {
            $prevRate = $rate + $changeAmount;
        } else {
            $prevRate = $rate;
        }

        $stmtInsDtl->execute([
            'hdr_id' => $hdrId,
            'currency_id' => $currencyId,
            'currency_code' => $currencyCode,
            'currency_name' => $currencyName,
            'unit_multiplier' => $multiplier,
            'rate' => $rate,
            'rate_per_unit' => $ratePerUnit,
            'prev_rate' => $prevRate,
            'change_amount' => $changeAmount,
            'change_direction' => $direction
        ]);

        $insertedCount++;
    }

    return [
        'success' => true,
        'hdr_id' => $hdrId,
        'kmk_no' => $kmkNo,
        'period' => "$startDate s/d $endDate",
        'items_count' => $insertedCount
    ];
}

if (php_sapi_name() === 'cli' || isset($_GET['run'])) {
    echo "=== FETCHING KURS PAJAK KEMENKEU ===\n";
    $res = fetchAndStoreTaxExchangeRates($pdo);
    if ($res['success']) {
        echo "SUKSES! KMK: {$res['kmk_no']} | Periode: {$res['period']} | Total Items: {$res['items_count']}\n";
    } else {
        echo "ERROR: {$res['message']}\n";
    }
}

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {

}

// 3. Cek Autentikasi User (Keamanan Dasar)
if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || empty($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    if (!empty($_SERVER['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH']) && strtolower($_SERVER['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH']) == 'xmlhttprequest') {
        http_response_code(401);
        echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Session expired. Silakan login kembali."]);
        exit;
    }
    header('Location: index.php');
    exit;

if (preg_match('/\/pdf\/([a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+\.php)/i', $requestUri, $matches)) {
    $pdfFileName = $matches[1];
    $possiblePaths = [
        __DIR__ . '/pdf/' . $pdfFileName,
        __DIR__ . '/../pdf/' . $pdfFileName,
        $_SERVER['DOCUMENT_ROOT'] . '/proyekgmn/pdf/' . $pdfFileName
    ];

    foreach ($possiblePaths as $pdfFilePath) {
        if (file_exists($pdfFilePath)) {
            chdir(dirname($pdfFilePath));
            require_once $pdfFilePath;
            exit;
        }
    }
}

// =========================================================================
// 3.2 BYPASS ROUTER KHUSUS AJAX POST / REQUEST CRUD EXTJS (FIX UTAMA)
// =========================================================================
$isAjax = (!empty($_SERVER['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH']) && strtolower($_SERVER['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH']) == 'xmlhttprequest');
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' || isset($_POST['task']) || $isAjax) {
    
    // Jika request mengarah langsung ke file CRUD di /php-crud/
    if (preg_match('/\/php-crud\/([a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+\.php)/i', $requestUri, $matches)) {
        $crudFile = __DIR__ . '/php-crud/' . $matches[1];
        if (file_exists($crudFile)) {
            chdir(__DIR__ . '/php-crud');
            require_once $crudFile;
            exit;
        }
    }
}
// =========================================================================

// 4. Load Database Class secara Absolut
require_once __DIR__ . '/php-class/crudClass.php';

// 5. Tangkap ID Menu dari Query String / Request / Session
$user_id = intval($_SESSION["user_id"]);
$form_id = 0;

    $form_id = intval($_REQUEST['menu_id']);

    $form_id = intval($_REQUEST['form_id']);
} elseif (isset($_GET['id'])) {
    $form_id = intval($_GET['id']);

    $form_id = intval($_GET['menu']);

if ($form_id <= 0) {
    http_response_code(400);
    die("Akses ditolak: Parameter menu ID tidak valid.");
}

// Simpan Form ID aktif ke Session agar request AJAX berikutnya dapat mengingatnya
$_SESSION['current_menu_id'] = $form_id;

try {
    $db = new crud();

    // 6. Verifikasi Hak Akses User & Ambil URL Target
    $sql = "
        SELECT f.id, f.title, f.php_url, u.access_level

    $formData = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    // Simpan Access Level ke Session agar dibaca oleh ExtJS formAccess

    $cleanFileName = preg_replace('/^(\.\.\/|php\/|\/)+/', '', $targetFile);

    if (file_exists($filePath)) {
        // Ubah working directory ke /php agar include internal file tidak error
        chdir(__DIR__ . '/views');

        // Tangkap output HTML dengan Buffer
        ob_start();
        include $cleanFileName;
        $htmlOutput = ob_get_clean();

        // A. Otomatis disisipkan <base href="/proyekgmn/"> agar semua path CSS/JS tidak broken
        /*
        if (stripos($htmlOutput, '<head>') !== false) {
            $htmlOutput = preg_replace('/<head>/i', "<head>\n  <base href=\"/proyekgmn/\">", $htmlOutput, 1);
        } else {
            $htmlOutput = "<base href=\"/proyekgmn/\">\n" . $htmlOutput;
        }
        */
        // B. AUTO-REPLACE STRING PATH RELATIF TANPA UBAH DUSUN FILE DARI FRONTEND
        $patterns = [
            '="../css/'      => '="/proyek/css/',
            '="../js/'       => '="/proyek/js/',
            '="../js-ext/'   => '="/proyek/js-ext/',
            '="../pdf/'      => '="/proyek/pdf/',
            '="../tcpdf_new/'=> '="/proyek/tcpdf_new/',
            '="../js-func/'  => '="/proyek/js-func/',
            '="../php-crud/' => '="/proyek/php-crud/',

        ];
        $htmlOutput = strtr($htmlOutput, $patterns);

        echo $htmlOutput;
        exit;
    } else {
        http_response_code(404);
        die("Error 404: File <b>" . htmlspecialchars($cleanFileName) . "</b> tidak ditemukan pada lokasi server.");
    }

} catch (Exception $e) {
    error_log("Router Error: " . $e->getMessage());
    http_response_code(500);
    die("Terjadi kesalahan pada server saat memproses navigasi.");
}
?>

/*
  Document      : financial_balance_sheet.js
  Description   : Balance Sheet (Neraca Keuangan) - Read-only report
  Backend       : /proyek/php-crud/balancesheetCRD.php
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Balance <em>Sheet</em>";

    ['addData', 'editData', 'deleteData'].forEach(function (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // 0. Container filter & report
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    var filterBarDiv = document.createElement('div');
    filterBarDiv.id = 'bsFilterBar';
    filterBarDiv.style.padding = '0 10px';

    var reportDiv = document.createElement('div');
    reportDiv.id = 'bsReportContainer';
    reportDiv.style.cssText = 'padding:15px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); color:#fff; margin:0 10px 10px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); font-size:13px;';

    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(filterBarDiv, gridContainer);
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(reportDiv, gridContainer);
    }

    // 1. Store Periode
    var periodField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'period_name' }, { name: 'start_date' }, { name: 'end_date' }];
    var periodDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/balancesheetCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_periods' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, periodField),
        listeners: {
            load: function (store) {
                if (store.getCount() > 0 && !fldPeriod.getValue()) {
                    fldPeriod.setValue(store.getAt(0).get('id'));
                    loadBalanceSheet();
                }
            }
        }
    });
    periodDs.load();

    // 2. Filter Bar
    var fldPeriod = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Periode', width: 220, store: periodDs, displayField: 'period_name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false
    });
    var btnShow = new Ext.Button({ text: 'Tampilkan', cls: 'field-button grey-field-button' });

    var filterPanel = new Ext.Panel({
        renderTo: 'bsFilterBar',
        layout: 'column',
        border: false,
        bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:8px 0;',
        defaults: { border: false, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;' },
        items: [
            { columnWidth: 0.35, layout: 'form', labelWidth: 60, items: fldPeriod },
            { columnWidth: 0.15, style: 'padding-top:2px;', items: btnShow }
        ]
    });

    function loadBalanceSheet() {
        var perId = fldPeriod.getValue();
        if (!perId) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih periode terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }

        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/balancesheetCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_balance_sheet', period_id: perId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    reportDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;">' + (res.message || 'Gagal memuat data.') + '</div>';
                    return;
                }
                renderBSView(res);
            }
        });
    }

    function renderBSView(res) {
        var fmt = function (val) { return Ext.util.Format.number(val || 0, '0,000.00'); };

        var balanceColor = res.is_balanced ? '#2e9e4f' : '#c0392b';
        var balanceText  = res.is_balanced ? 'BALANCE ✓' : 'TIDAK BALANCE ✗';

        var html = '<h2 style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:4px; font-weight:normal;">NERACA KEUANGAN</h2>' +
                   '<h4 style="text-align:center; color:#bbb; margin-top:0; font-weight:normal;">Per Tanggal: ' + res.as_of_date + ' (' + res.period_name + ')</h4>' +
                   '<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:15px;"><b style="color:' + balanceColor + '; font-size:14px;">[ STATUS: ' + balanceText + ' ]</b></div>' +
                   '<hr style="border:0; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); margin:15px 0;" />';

        html += '<table width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse;" color:"#ffeb3b"; font-size:"13px";"cellpadding="6">' +
                '<tr style="vertical-align:top;">' +

                // KOLOM KIRI: ASET
                '<td width="50%" style="border-right:1px solid rgb(138, 0, 0); padding-right:15px;">' +
                    '<h3 style="color:#98db34; margin-bottom:8px;">ASET (AKTIVA)</h3>' +
                    '<table width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse;">';
        
        Ext.each(res.assets, function (a) {
            html += '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); color:#ffeb3b ;">' +
                    '<td>' + a.account_code + '</td>' +
                    '<td>' + a.account_name + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="right">' + fmt(a.balance) + '</td>' +
                    '</tr>';
        });

        html += '</table>' +
                '<div style="margin-top:20px; padding:10px; background:rgba(234, 0, 255, 0.05);color: #98db34; font-weight:bold; display:flex; justify-content:space-between;">' +
                '<span>TOTAL ASET</span>' +
                '<span style="color:#98db34;">' + fmt(res.total_asset) + '</span>' +
                '</div>' +
                '</td>' +

                // KOLOM KANAN: LIABILITAS & EKUITAS
                '<td width="50%" style="padding-left:15px;">' +
                    '<h3 style="color:#f39c12; margin-bottom:8px;">LIABILITAS (KEWAJIBAN)</h3>' +
                    '<table width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse; margin-bottom:15px;color: #f39c12;">';
        
        Ext.each(res.liabilities, function (l) {
            html += '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);">' +
                    '<td>' + l.account_code + '</td>' +
                    '<td>' + l.account_name + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="right">' + fmt(l.balance) + '</td>' +
                    '</tr>';
        });

        html += '<tr style="font-weight:bold; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03);">' +
                '<td colspan="2">TOTAL LIABILITAS</td>' +
                '<td align="right">' + fmt(res.total_liability) + '</td>' +
                '</tr></table>' +

                '<h3 style="color:#f39c12; margin-bottom:8px;">EKUITAS (MODAL)</h3>' +
                '<table width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse;color: #f39c12;">';

        Ext.each(res.equities, function (eq) {
            html += '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);">' +
                    '<td>' + eq.account_code + '</td>' +
                    '<td>' + eq.account_name + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="right">' + fmt(eq.balance) + '</td>' +
                    '</tr>';
        });

        html += '<tr style="font-weight:bold; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03);">' +
                '<td colspan="2">TOTAL EKUITAS</td>' +
                '<td align="right">' + fmt(res.total_equity) + '</td>' +
                '</tr></table>' +

                '<div style="margin-top:20px; padding:10px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); font-weight:bold; display:flex; justify-content:space-between;color: #f39c12;">' +
                '<span>TOTAL LIABILITAS & EKUITAS</span>' +
                '<span style="color:#f39c12;">' + fmt(res.total_liability_equity) + '</span>' +
                '</div>' +

                '</td>' +
                '</tr>' +
                '</table>';

        reportDiv.innerHTML = html;
    }

    btnShow.on('click', loadBalanceSheet);

    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function () {
        var perId = fldPeriod.getValue();
        if (!perId) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih periode terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        window.open('../pdf/balancesheet.php?period_id=' + perId, 'sub', 'toolbar=no', 'location=no', 'status=no', 'directories=no', 'menubar=no');
    };

    if (document.getElementById('popOK')) {
        document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
        };
    }
});

## File: ./js/bin.location.js
