<?php
/*
  Document      : Supplier Payment - Backend Controller (Full CRUD + AutoPostJournal Engine)
  Called from   : js/purchase_payment.js
  Note          : Pola mengikuti paymentCRD.php (AR) persis, dibalik sisi
                  debit-kreditnya untuk AP:
                    Payment Entry (AR): Debit Kas/Bank (override) / Kredit Piutang
                    Supplier Payment (AP): Debit Hutang Usaha / Kredit Kas/Bank (override)
                  reference_type = 'supplier_payment' (dipakai utk rule AP
                  MAUPUN Advance -- tidak ada enum terpisah spt customer_deposit)
*/
/*
  PERUBAHAN (perbaikan dari versi yang sudah berjalan)
  - create/update/delete kini SATU transaksi (sebelumnya create autocommit: bila jurnal gagal,
    header + item + paid_amount tetap tersimpan dan user melihat error -> retry = pembayaran dobel).
  - validasi server: invoice ada, milik supplier yang dipilih, nominal <= sisa tagihan, tidak dobel.
  - paid_amount dihitung ulang dari supplier_payment_items (bukan +/- manual dengan GREATEST).
  - saldo deposit tidak boleh negatif (hapus/ubah pembayaran yang uang mukanya sudah terpakai ditolak).
  - nomor SPAY & JV satu-transaksi (butuh CreateRefNoDb di function.all.php baru; ada fallback).
  - task baru read_payment_method; task read_* membaca $_REQUEST (POST maupun GET).
*/
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || empty($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Session expired. Silakan login kembali."]);
    exit;
}

$task = $_POST['task'] ?? $_REQUEST['task'] ?? 'read';
$db   = new crud();

switch ($task) {

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. READ (Grid Utama)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read':
        $sql = "
            SELECT p.id, p.payment_no, p.payment_date, p.supplier_id,
                   s.name AS supplier_name,
                   p.account_id, (coa.account_code || ' - ' || coa.account_name) AS account_name,
                   p.payment_method, p.total_amount, COALESCE(p.allocated_amount, 0) AS allocated_amount,
                   COALESCE(p.excess_amount, 0) AS excess_amount,
                   COALESCE(p.deposit_applied, 0) AS deposit_applied,
                   p.reference_no, p.notes
            FROM supplier_payments p
            LEFT JOIN m_suppliers s ON s.id = p.supplier_id
            LEFT JOIN chart_of_accounts coa ON coa.id = p.account_id
            ORDER BY p.payment_date DESC, p.id DESC
            LIMIT 250
        ";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data]);
        break;
// ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1B. READ PAYMENT DETAIL (Alokasi Invoice yang Dibayar)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_payment_detail':
        $paymentId = intval($_REQUEST['payment_id'] ?? $_REQUEST['payment_id'] ?? 0);

        if ($paymentId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => []]);
            exit;
        }

        $sql = "
            SELECT 
                pi.inv_no AS invoice_no,
                pi.supplier_invoice_no,
                TO_CHAR(pi.invoice_date, 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS invoice_date,
                COALESCE(pi.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount,
                COALESCE(pi.total_amount - pi.paid_amount, 0) AS unpaid_amount,
                COALESCE(spi.amount_paid, 0) AS amount_paid
            FROM supplier_payment_items spi
            INNER JOIN purchase_invoice_hdr pi ON spi.invoice_id = pi.id
            WHERE spi.supplier_payment_id = :payment_id
            ORDER BY pi.id ASC
        ";

        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(['payment_id' => $paymentId]);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;



    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. READ SINGLE (Form Edit)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_edit':
        $id = intval($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT p.*, (p.payment_date)::text AS payment_date
            FROM supplier_payments p
            WHERE p.id = :id
        ");
        $stmt->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => (bool)$row, 'data' => $row ?: new stdClass()]);
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. READ COMBO & UNPAID PURCHASE INVOICES
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_supplier':
        $sql = "SELECT id, name FROM m_suppliers WHERE active = true ORDER BY name ASC";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)]);
        break;

    case 'read_account':
        $sql = "
            SELECT id, (account_code || ' - ' || account_name) AS account_name
            FROM chart_of_accounts
            WHERE is_active = true
              AND parent_id IS NOT NULL
              AND (
                  account_type IN ('cash', 'bank')
                  OR parent_id = (SELECT id FROM chart_of_accounts WHERE account_code = '1100' LIMIT 1)
              )
            ORDER BY account_code ASC
        ";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)]);
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3B. READ METODE PEMBAYARAN
    //     Bila kolom payment_method bertipe ENUM, nilainya diambil dari DB
    //     (supaya combo di form tidak pernah mengirim nilai yang ditolak enum).
    //     Bila bukan enum, dipakai daftar default.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_payment_method':
        $rows = [];
        try {
            $rows = $db->query("
                SELECT e.enumlabel AS value
                FROM pg_attribute a
                JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid = a.atttypid
                JOIN pg_enum e ON e.enumtypid = t.oid
                WHERE a.attrelid = 'supplier_payments'::regclass
                  AND a.attname = 'payment_method'
                ORDER BY e.enumsortorder
            ")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $rows = [];
        }
        if (empty($rows)) {
            $rows = [['value' => 'BANK_TRANSFER'], ['value' => 'CASH'], ['value' => 'CHEQUE']];
        }
        foreach ($rows as &$mr) {
            $mr['label'] = ucwords(strtolower(str_replace('_', ' ', $mr['value'])));
        }
        unset($mr);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $rows]);
        break;

    case 'read_unpaid_invoices':
        $supplierId = intval($_REQUEST['supplier_id'] ?? 0);
        $paymentId  = intval($_REQUEST['payment_id'] ?? 0);

        if ($supplierId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => 0, 'data' => []]);
            exit;
        }

        // payment_id = 0 → mode tambah: amount_paid default ke unpaid_amount (sisa hutang)
        // payment_id > 0 → mode edit: amount_paid dari supplier_payment_items (alokasi tersimpan)
        $sql = "
            SELECT
                i.id AS invoice_id,
                i.inv_no AS invoice_no,
                i.supplier_invoice_no,
                i.invoice_date,
                i.total_amount,
                i.paid_amount,
                ((COALESCE(i.total_amount, 0) - COALESCE(i.paid_amount, 0)) + COALESCE(pi.amount_paid, 0)) AS unpaid_amount,
                CASE
                    WHEN :payment_id2 = 0
                        THEN ((COALESCE(i.total_amount, 0) - COALESCE(i.paid_amount, 0)) + COALESCE(pi.amount_paid, 0))
                    ELSE COALESCE(pi.amount_paid, 0)
                END AS amount_paid
            FROM purchase_invoice_hdr i
            LEFT JOIN supplier_payment_items pi ON pi.invoice_id = i.id AND pi.supplier_payment_id = :payment_id
            WHERE i.supplier_id = :supplier_id
              AND i.status = 'posted'
              AND (((COALESCE(i.total_amount, 0) - COALESCE(i.paid_amount, 0)) + COALESCE(pi.amount_paid, 0)) > 0.01 OR pi.id IS NOT NULL)
            ORDER BY i.invoice_date ASC, i.id ASC
        ";

        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(['supplier_id' => $supplierId, 'payment_id' => $paymentId, 'payment_id2' => $paymentId]);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Saldo Deposit di Supplier -- dihitung dari journal_lines (net
    // debit-kredit akun 1400 Uang Muka Pembelian) terkait supplier_payments
    // milik supplier ini. Tidak ada tabel ledger baru.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_supplier_deposit_balance':
        $supplierId = intval($_REQUEST['supplier_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($supplierId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'balance' => 0]);
            exit;
        }
        $balance = GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $supplierId);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'balance' => $balance]);
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. CREATE  (satu transaksi: header + item + paid_amount + jurnal)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'create':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 2) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }

        $rawTotal   = str_replace(',', '', $_POST['total_amount'] ?? '0');
        $totalPaid  = round(floatval($rawTotal), 2);
        $depositApplied = round(floatval($_POST['deposit_applied'] ?? 0), 2);
        $supplierId = intval($_POST['supplier_id'] ?? 0);
        $accountId  = intval($_POST['account_id'] ?? 0);
        $payDate    = trim($_POST['payment_date'] ?? '');
        $method     = trim($_POST['payment_method'] ?? 'BANK_TRANSFER');
        $refNo      = trim($_POST['reference_no'] ?? '');
        $notes      = trim($_POST['notes'] ?? '');
        $items      = json_decode($_POST['arrItems'] ?? '[]', true);

        if ($supplierId <= 0 || empty($payDate) || ($totalPaid <= 0 && $depositApplied <= 0)) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Lengkapi data pembayaran. Total dibayar atau saldo deposit yang dipakai harus > 0.']);
            exit;
        }
        if ($totalPaid > 0 && $accountId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Pilih akun Kas/Bank sumber dana.']);
            exit;
        }
        $dtChk = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', $payDate);
        if (!$dtChk || $dtChk->format('Y-m-d') !== $payDate) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Format Tanggal Bayar tidak valid (harus YYYY-MM-DD).']);
            exit;
        }

        if ($db->inTransaction()) {
            try { $db->rollBack(); } catch (Exception $ex) {}
        }

        try {
            $db->beginTransaction();

            // Serialisasi per supplier: dua pembayaran bersamaan tidak bisa
            // sama-sama memakai saldo deposit / melunasi invoice yang sama.
            SpLockSupplier($db, $supplierId);
            $before = [$supplierId => GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $supplierId)];

            $alloc = SpNormalizeItems($items);
            $allocatedTotal = round(array_sum($alloc), 2);

            if ($depositApplied > 0) {
                $availableDeposit = $before[$supplierId];
                if ($depositApplied > $availableDeposit + 0.01) {
                    throw new Exception("Saldo deposit yang dipakai (Rp " . number_format($depositApplied, 2) . ") melebihi saldo tersedia (Rp " . number_format($availableDeposit, 2) . ").");
                }
                if ($depositApplied > $allocatedTotal + 0.01) {
                    throw new Exception('Saldo deposit yang dipakai tidak boleh melebihi total alokasi ke invoice.');
                }
            }

            $cashNeeded = round($allocatedTotal - $depositApplied, 2);
            if ($totalPaid + 0.01 < $cashNeeded) {
                throw new Exception("Total dibayar + saldo deposit belum cukup menutupi alokasi invoice.");
            }
            $excessAmount = round($totalPaid - $cashNeeded, 2);

            // invoice ada, milik supplier ini, nominal <= sisa tagihan (baris dikunci)
            SpValidateAllocations($db, $supplierId, $alloc);

            $paymentNo = SpNextRefNo($db, 'supplier_payments', 'payment_no', 'SPAY');

            $createdBy = null;
            $rawUserId = intval($_SESSION['user_id'] ?? 0);
            if ($rawUserId > 0) {
                $stmtUser = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM m_user_system WHERE id = :uid LIMIT 1");
                $stmtUser->execute(['uid' => $rawUserId]);
                if ($stmtUser->fetchColumn()) {
                    $createdBy = $rawUserId;
                }
            }

            $okHeader = $db->insert('supplier_payments', [
                'payment_no'       => $paymentNo,
                'payment_date'     => $payDate,
                'supplier_id'      => $supplierId,
                'account_id'       => $totalPaid > 0 ? $accountId : null,
                'payment_method'   => $method,
                'total_amount'     => $totalPaid,
                'allocated_amount' => $allocatedTotal,
                'excess_amount'    => $excessAmount,
                'deposit_applied'  => $depositApplied,
                'reference_no'     => $refNo,
                'notes'            => $notes,
                'created_by'       => $createdBy
            ]);
            if ($okHeader === false) {
                throw new Exception('ERROR ASLI DB HEADER: ' . $db->getResult());
            }

            $stmtP = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM supplier_payments WHERE payment_no = :no ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1");
            $stmtP->execute(['no' => $paymentNo]);
            $paymentId = intval($stmtP->fetchColumn());
            if ($paymentId <= 0) {
                throw new Exception('ERROR ASLI DB HEADER: id pembayaran tidak terbaca setelah insert.');
            }

            foreach ($alloc as $invId => $amt) {
                $okItem = $db->insert('supplier_payment_items', [
                    'supplier_payment_id' => $paymentId,
                    'invoice_id'          => $invId,
                    'amount_paid'         => $amt
                ]);
                if ($okItem === false) {
                    throw new Exception("ERROR ASLI DB ITEM (Invoice ID {$invId}): " . $db->getResult());
                }
            }

            // paid_amount dihitung dari item (sumber kebenaran), bukan ditambah manual
            SpRecalcInvoicePaid($db, array_keys($alloc));

            try {
                PostSupplierPaymentJournal($db, $paymentId, $paymentNo, $payDate, $accountId, $allocatedTotal, $excessAmount, $depositApplied);
            } catch (Exception $e) {
                throw new Exception('ERROR ASLI POST JURNAL: ' . $e->getMessage());
            }

            SpAssertDepositNotNegative($db, $before);

            $db->commit();
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'id' => $paymentId, 'payment_no' => $paymentNo, 'message' => "Pembayaran {$paymentNo} berhasil disimpan."]);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) {
                try { $db->rollBack(); } catch (Exception $ex) {}
            }
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
            exit;
        }
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. UPDATE
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'update':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 3) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }

        $id          = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        $supplierId  = intval($_POST['supplier_id'] ?? 0);
        $accountId   = intval($_POST['account_id'] ?? 0);
        $payDate     = trim($_POST['payment_date'] ?? '');
        $method      = trim($_POST['payment_method'] ?? 'BANK_TRANSFER');
        $refNo       = trim($_POST['reference_no'] ?? '');
        $notes       = trim($_POST['notes'] ?? '');
        $items       = json_decode($_POST['arrItems'] ?? '[]', true);

        $rawTotal  = str_replace(',', '', $_POST['total_amount'] ?? '0');
        $totalPaid = round(floatval($rawTotal), 2);
        $depositApplied = round(floatval($_POST['deposit_applied'] ?? 0), 2);

        if ($id <= 0 || $supplierId <= 0 || empty($payDate) || ($totalPaid <= 0 && $depositApplied <= 0)) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Data edit tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }
        if ($totalPaid > 0 && $accountId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Pilih akun Kas/Bank sumber dana.']);
            exit;
        }
        $dtChk = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', $payDate);
        if (!$dtChk || $dtChk->format('Y-m-d') !== $payDate) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Format Tanggal Bayar tidak valid (harus YYYY-MM-DD).']);
            exit;
        }

        if ($db->inTransaction()) {
            try { $db->rollBack(); } catch (Exception $ex) {}
        }

        try {
            $db->beginTransaction();

            $stmtOldPay = $db->prepare("SELECT payment_no, supplier_id FROM supplier_payments WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
            $stmtOldPay->execute(['id' => $id]);
            $oldPay = $stmtOldPay->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$oldPay) {
                throw new Exception("Data pembayaran tidak ditemukan.");
            }
            $oldPayNo       = $oldPay['payment_no'];
            $oldSupplierId  = intval($oldPay['supplier_id']);

            // kunci supplier lama & baru (urut id supaya tidak deadlock) + catat saldo deposit awal
            $sids = array_values(array_unique([$oldSupplierId, $supplierId]));
            sort($sids);
            $before = [];
            foreach ($sids as $sid) {
                SpLockSupplier($db, $sid);
                $before[$sid] = GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $sid);
            }

            $stmtOldItems = $db->prepare("SELECT invoice_id FROM supplier_payment_items WHERE supplier_payment_id = :id");
            $stmtOldItems->execute(['id' => $id]);
            $oldInvoiceIds = array_map('intval', $stmtOldItems->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN));

            $alloc = SpNormalizeItems($items);
            SpLockInvoices($db, array_merge($oldInvoiceIds, array_keys($alloc)));

            ReverseSupplierPaymentJournal($db, $id);

            $stmtDelItems = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM supplier_payment_items WHERE supplier_payment_id = :id");
            $stmtDelItems->execute(['id' => $id]);

            $allocatedTotal = round(array_sum($alloc), 2);

            if ($depositApplied > 0) {
                // dihitung SETELAH jurnal lama dibalik -> pemakaian deposit oleh pembayaran ini sendiri sudah kembali
                $availableDeposit = GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $supplierId);
                if ($depositApplied > $availableDeposit + 0.01) {
                    throw new Exception("Saldo deposit yang dipakai melebihi saldo tersedia (Rp " . number_format($availableDeposit, 2) . ").");
                }
                if ($depositApplied > $allocatedTotal + 0.01) {
                    throw new Exception('Saldo deposit yang dipakai tidak boleh melebihi total alokasi ke invoice.');
                }
            }

            $cashNeeded = round($allocatedTotal - $depositApplied, 2);
            if ($totalPaid + 0.01 < $cashNeeded) {
                throw new Exception('Total dibayar + saldo deposit belum cukup menutupi alokasi invoice.');
            }
            $excessAmount = round($totalPaid - $cashNeeded, 2);

            // item lama sudah dihapus -> "pembayaran lain" saja yang dihitung sebagai terbayar
            SpValidateAllocations($db, $supplierId, $alloc);

            $okUpd = $db->update('supplier_payments', [
                'payment_date'     => $payDate,
                'supplier_id'      => $supplierId,
                'account_id'       => $totalPaid > 0 ? $accountId : null,
                'payment_method'   => $method,
                'total_amount'     => $totalPaid,
                'allocated_amount' => $allocatedTotal,
                'excess_amount'    => $excessAmount,
                'deposit_applied'  => $depositApplied,
                'reference_no'     => $refNo,
                'notes'            => $notes
            ], "id = " . intval($id));

            if ($okUpd === false) {
                throw new Exception("GAGAL UPDATE HEADER: " . $db->getResult());
            }

            foreach ($alloc as $invId => $amt) {
                $okInsItem = $db->insert('supplier_payment_items', ['supplier_payment_id' => $id, 'invoice_id' => $invId, 'amount_paid' => $amt]);
                if ($okInsItem === false) {
                    throw new Exception("GAGAL INSERT ITEM UPDATE (Invoice ID {$invId}): " . $db->getResult());
                }
            }

            SpRecalcInvoicePaid($db, array_merge($oldInvoiceIds, array_keys($alloc)));

            PostSupplierPaymentJournal($db, $id, $oldPayNo, $payDate, $accountId, $allocatedTotal, $excessAmount, $depositApplied);

            SpAssertDepositNotNegative($db, $before);

            $db->commit();
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Pembayaran {$oldPayNo} berhasil diperbarui."]);

        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) {
                try { $db->rollBack(); } catch (Exception $ex) {}
            }
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ERROR UPDATE: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
            exit;
        }
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 6. DELETE
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'delete':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 4) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }

        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID data tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }

        if ($db->inTransaction()) {
            try { $db->rollBack(); } catch (Exception $ex) {}
        }

        try {
            $db->beginTransaction();

            $stmtOldPay = $db->prepare("SELECT payment_no, supplier_id FROM supplier_payments WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
            $stmtOldPay->execute(['id' => $id]);
            $oldPay = $stmtOldPay->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$oldPay) {
                throw new Exception("Data pembayaran tidak ditemukan.");
            }
            $oldPayNo = $oldPay['payment_no'];
            $delSupplierId = intval($oldPay['supplier_id']);

            SpLockSupplier($db, $delSupplierId);
            $before = [$delSupplierId => GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $delSupplierId)];

            $stmtOldItems = $db->prepare("SELECT invoice_id FROM supplier_payment_items WHERE supplier_payment_id = :id");
            $stmtOldItems->execute(['id' => $id]);
            $oldInvoiceIds = array_map('intval', $stmtOldItems->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN));
            SpLockInvoices($db, $oldInvoiceIds);

            ReverseSupplierPaymentJournal($db, $id);

            $stmtDelItems = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM supplier_payment_items WHERE supplier_payment_id = :id");
            $stmtDelItems->execute(['id' => $id]);

            $stmtDelHeader = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM supplier_payments WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtDelHeader->execute(['id' => $id]);

            SpRecalcInvoicePaid($db, $oldInvoiceIds);

            // uang muka dari pembayaran ini mungkin sudah dipakai pembayaran lain
            SpAssertDepositNotNegative($db, $before);

            $db->commit();
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Pembayaran {$oldPayNo} berhasil dihapus & jurnal dibatalkan."]);

        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) {
                try { $db->rollBack(); } catch (Exception $ex) {}
            }
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ERROR DELETE: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
            exit;
        }
        break;

    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali.']);
}

// ==================================================================
// HELPER LOKAL
// ==================================================================
function PostSupplierPaymentJournal($db, $paymentId, $paymentNo, $payDate, $cashAccountId, $allocatedTotal, $excessAmount, $depositApplied = 0) {
    $cashPortionAp = round($allocatedTotal - $depositApplied, 2);

    // (0) Porsi yang dilunasi pakai saldo deposit di supplier -> Debit
    //     Hutang Usaha (2100, fixed) / Kredit Uang Muka Pembelian (1400,
    //     fixed). Tidak ada akun yang perlu di-override di sini.
    if ($depositApplied > 0) {
        $resultDep = AutoPostJournal($db, [
            'rule_code'      => 'SUP_PAY_DEP',
            'reference_type' => 'supplier_payment',
            'reference_id'   => $paymentId,
            'journal_date'   => $payDate,
            'amount'         => $depositApplied,
            'description'    => 'Pelunasan Hutang Pakai Deposit ' . $paymentNo,
        ]);
        if (!$resultDep['success']) {
            throw new Exception($resultDep['message']);
        }
    }

    // (1) Porsi yang mengurangi Hutang Usaha pakai kas/bank -> Debit Hutang Usaha (fixed) / Kredit Kas-Bank (override)
    if ($cashPortionAp > 0) {
        $resultAp = AutoPostJournal($db, [
            'rule_code'         => 'SUP_PAY_AP',
            'reference_type'    => 'supplier_payment',
            'reference_id'      => $paymentId,
            'journal_date'      => $payDate,
            'amount'            => $cashPortionAp,
            'description'       => 'Pembayaran Hutang ' . $paymentNo,
            'credit_account_id' => $cashAccountId, // akun Kas/Bank pilihan user
        ]);
        if (!$resultAp['success']) {
            throw new Exception($resultAp['message']);
        }
    }

    // (2) Porsi lebih bayar -> Debit Uang Muka Pembelian (fixed) / Kredit Kas-Bank (override)
    if ($excessAmount > 0) {
        $resultAdv = AutoPostJournal($db, [
            'rule_code'         => 'SUP_PAY_ADV',
            'reference_type'    => 'supplier_payment',
            'reference_id'      => $paymentId,
            'journal_date'      => $payDate,
            'amount'            => $excessAmount,
            'description'       => 'Uang Muka Pembelian dari Pembayaran ' . $paymentNo,
            'credit_account_id' => $cashAccountId, // akun Kas/Bank pilihan user
        ]);
        if (!$resultAdv['success']) {
            throw new Exception($resultAdv['message']);
        }
    }

    if ($allocatedTotal <= 0 && $excessAmount <= 0 && $depositApplied <= 0) {
        throw new Exception('Tidak ada nominal untuk diposting ke jurnal.');
    }
}

function ReverseSupplierPaymentJournal($db, $paymentId) {
    // Kedua rule (AP & Advance) sama-sama pakai reference_type
    // 'supplier_payment' -- satu panggilan ini menghapus keduanya sekaligus.
    ReverseJournalByReference($db, 'supplier_payment', $paymentId);
}

/*
  Hitung saldo deposit tersedia di seorang supplier, langsung dari
  journal_lines (net debit-kredit akun 1400 Uang Muka Pembelian), dilacak
  lewat reference_type='supplier_payment' + reference_id = id di
  supplier_payments milik supplier ini.
*/
function GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $supplierId) {
    $sql = "
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jl.debit - jl.credit), 0) AS balance
        FROM journal_lines jl
        JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_id
        JOIN chart_of_accounts coa ON coa.id = jl.account_id AND coa.account_code = '1400'
        WHERE je.reference_type = 'supplier_payment'
          AND je.reference_id IN (
              SELECT id FROM supplier_payments WHERE supplier_id = :supplier_id
          )
    ";
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    $stmt->execute(['supplier_id' => $supplierId]);
    $balance = floatval($stmt->fetchColumn());
    return round($balance, 2);
}


// ==================================================================
// HELPER TAMBAHAN (validasi server, penguncian, hitung ulang paid_amount)
// ==================================================================

/** Placeholder :p0,:p1,... untuk klausa IN. */
function SpInList(array $ids, $prefix, array &$params) {
    $ph = [];
    foreach (array_values($ids) as $i => $v) {
        $ph[] = ':' . $prefix . $i;
        $params[$prefix . $i] = (int)$v;
    }
    return implode(',', $ph);
}

/** Nomor referensi satu-transaksi (lihat CreateRefNoDb di function.all.php); fallback ke CreateRefNo. */
function SpNextRefNo($db, $table, $column, $prefix) {
    $no = function_exists('CreateRefNoDb')
        ? CreateRefNoDb($db, $table, $column, $prefix)
        : CreateRefNo($table, $column, $prefix);
    if ($no === '' || $no === null) {
        throw new Exception('Gagal generate nomor dokumen (' . $prefix . ').');
    }
    return $no;
}

/** Kunci per supplier selama transaksi (advisory lock, lepas otomatis saat COMMIT/ROLLBACK). */
function SpLockSupplier($db, $supplierId) {
    $supplierId = intval($supplierId);
    if ($supplierId <= 0) { return; }
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(7101, CAST(:sid AS integer))");
    $st->execute(['sid' => $supplierId]);
}

/** Baris items dari browser -> [invoice_id => nominal]. Baris kosong dilewati; invoice dobel ditolak. */
function SpNormalizeItems($items) {
    $alloc = [];
    if (!is_array($items)) { return $alloc; }
    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $invId = intval($it['invoice_id'] ?? 0);
        $amt   = round(floatval($it['amount_paid'] ?? 0), 2);
        if ($invId <= 0 || $amt <= 0) { continue; }
        if (isset($alloc[$invId])) {
            throw new Exception('Invoice yang sama tidak boleh muncul dua kali dalam satu pembayaran.');
        }
        $alloc[$invId] = $amt;
    }
    return $alloc;
}

/** Kunci baris invoice (urut id). */
function SpLockInvoices($db, array $ids) {
    $ids = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_map('intval', $ids))));
    if (empty($ids)) { return; }
    sort($ids);
    $params = [];
    $in = SpInList($ids, 'l', $params);
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM purchase_invoice_hdr WHERE id IN ($in) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE");
    $st->execute($params);
}

/**
 * Invoice harus ada, milik supplier yang dipilih, dan nominal <= sisa tagihan.
 * Sisa = total - SUM(item pembayaran yang ada di DB saat ini); pada update, item lama
 * pembayaran ini sudah dihapus lebih dulu, jadi hanya pembayaran LAIN yang dihitung.
 */
function SpValidateAllocations($db, $supplierId, array $alloc) {
    if (empty($alloc)) { return; }
    $ids = array_keys($alloc);
    SpLockInvoices($db, $ids);

    $params = [];
    $in = SpInList($ids, 'v', $params);
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT inv.id, inv.inv_no, inv.supplier_id,
               COALESCE(inv.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount,
               COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.amount_paid) FROM supplier_payment_items i WHERE i.invoice_id = inv.id), 0) AS paid_now
        FROM purchase_invoice_hdr inv
        WHERE inv.id IN ($in)
    ");
    $st->execute($params);
    $map = [];
    foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) { $map[intval($r['id'])] = $r; }

    foreach ($alloc as $invId => $amt) {
        if (!isset($map[$invId])) {
            throw new Exception("Invoice (id {$invId}) tidak ditemukan.");
        }
        $r = $map[$invId];
        if (intval($r['supplier_id']) !== intval($supplierId)) {
            throw new Exception("Invoice {$r['inv_no']} milik supplier yang berbeda dengan pembayaran ini.");
        }
        $outstanding = round((float)$r['total_amount'] - (float)$r['paid_now'], 2);
        if ($amt > $outstanding + 0.01) {
            throw new Exception("Pembayaran untuk invoice {$r['inv_no']} (Rp " . number_format($amt, 2) . ") melebihi sisa tagihan (Rp " . number_format($outstanding, 2) . ").");
        }
    }
}

/** paid_amount = SUM(item pembayaran). Idempotent, tidak ada GREATEST(0, ...) yang menyembunyikan selisih. */
function SpRecalcInvoicePaid($db, array $ids) {
    $ids = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_map('intval', $ids))));
    if (empty($ids)) { return; }
    sort($ids);
    $params = [];
    $in = SpInList($ids, 'r', $params);
    $st = $db->prepare("
        UPDATE purchase_invoice_hdr AS h
           SET paid_amount = COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.amount_paid) FROM supplier_payment_items i WHERE i.invoice_id = h.id), 0)
         WHERE h.id IN ($in)
    ");
    $st->execute($params);
}

/**
 * Saldo deposit supplier tidak boleh menjadi negatif akibat operasi ini.
 * $before = [supplier_id => saldo sebelum operasi]. Bila saldo sudah negatif sebelumnya dan
 * tidak bertambah buruk, operasi tetap diizinkan.
 */
function SpAssertDepositNotNegative($db, array $before) {
    foreach ($before as $sid => $b) {
        $after = GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $sid);
        if ($after < -0.01 && $after < $b - 0.01) {
            throw new Exception("Saldo deposit supplier akan menjadi negatif (Rp " . number_format($after, 2) . "). Uang muka dari pembayaran ini sudah dipakai pembayaran lain -- batalkan/ubah pembayaran yang memakainya terlebih dahulu.");
        }
    }
}

## File: ./php-crud/clientsCRD.php

<?php
/**
 * clientsCRD.php
 * ============================================================
 * Backend Controller untuk Master Klien (public.clients).
 * Dipulihkan untuk clients.js -- kontrak task & field mengikuti
 * persis apa yang sudah dipanggil di JS tsb:
 *   list, read_edit, create, update, delete
 *
 * Catatan: projects.client_id punya ON DELETE SET NULL, jadi hapus
 * klien yang masih dipakai proyek AMAN di level database (proyeknya
 * tidak ikut terhapus, cuma client_id-nya jadi kosong) -- sesuai
 * peringatan yang sudah ditampilkan clients.js sebelum submit delete.
 * ============================================================
 */

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

session_start();
header('Content-Type: application/json');

$task = $_REQUEST['task'] ?? '';
$db   = new crud();

function PrepOrFailCL($stmt, $context = '') {
    if ($stmt === false) {
        throw new Exception(($context ? "[{$context}] " : '') . 'Query gagal dijalankan.');
    }
    return $stmt;
}
function clFetchAll($db, $sql, array $params = [], $ctx = '') {
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    PrepOrFailCL($stmt, $ctx);
    $stmt->execute($params);
    return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
}
function clFetchOne($db, $sql, array $params = [], $ctx = '') {
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    PrepOrFailCL($stmt, $ctx);
    $stmt->execute($params);
    $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    return $row === false ? null : $row;
}
function clExec($db, $sql, array $params = [], $ctx = '') {
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    PrepOrFailCL($stmt, $ctx);
    $stmt->execute($params);
    return $stmt;
}

$access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);

try {
    switch ($task) {

        case 'list':
            $sql = "SELECT c.id, c.name, c.contact_person, c.phone, c.email, c.address, c.created_at,
                           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects p WHERE p.client_id = c.id) AS project_count
                    FROM clients c
                    ORDER BY c.name ASC";
            $data = clFetchAll($db, $sql, [], 'list');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data]);
            break;

        case 'read_edit':
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            $row = clFetchOne($db, "SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = :id", ['id' => $id], 'read_edit');
            if (!$row) throw new Exception('Data klien tidak ditemukan.');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $row]);
            break;

        // --------------------------------------------------------------
        case 'create':
        case 'update':
            if ($task === 'create' && $access < 2) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menambah klien.']);
                exit;
            }
            if ($task === 'update' && $access < 3) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk mengubah klien.']);
                exit;
            }

            $id             = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            $name           = trim($_REQUEST['name'] ?? '');
            $contact_person = trim($_REQUEST['contact_person'] ?? '');
            $phone          = trim($_REQUEST['phone'] ?? '');
            $email          = trim($_REQUEST['email'] ?? '');
            $address        = $_REQUEST['address'] ?? '';

            if ($name === '') throw new Exception('Nama Klien wajib diisi.');
            if ($email !== '' && !filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
                throw new Exception('Format email tidak valid.');
            }

            if ($task === 'create') {
                $newId = (int)clFetchOne($db,
                    "INSERT INTO clients (name, contact_person, phone, email, address, created_at)
                     VALUES (:name, :cp, :phone, :email, :address, NOW())
                     RETURNING id",
                    ['name' => $name, 'cp' => $contact_person, 'phone' => $phone, 'email' => $email, 'address' => $address],
                    'insert clients')['id'];
                echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'id' => $newId, 'name' => $name, 'message' => "Klien '{$name}' berhasil ditambahkan."]);
            } else {
                if (!$id) throw new Exception('ID klien tidak valid.');
                clExec($db,
                    "UPDATE clients SET name = :name, contact_person = :cp, phone = :phone, email = :email, address = :address
                     WHERE id = :id",
                    ['name' => $name, 'cp' => $contact_person, 'phone' => $phone, 'email' => $email, 'address' => $address, 'id' => $id],
                    'update clients');
                echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'name' => $name, 'message' => "Klien '{$name}' berhasil diperbarui."]);
            }
            break;

        case 'delete':
            if ($access < 4) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menghapus klien.']);
                exit;
            }
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            if (!$id) throw new Exception('ID klien tidak valid.');

            clExec($db, "DELETE FROM clients WHERE id = :id", ['id' => $id], 'delete clients');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Klien berhasil dihapus.']);
            break;

        default:
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali.']);
            break;
    }
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage() !== '' ? $e->getMessage() : 'Terjadi kesalahan pada server.']);
}

                        "customer_id"  => $customerId,

                        "contact_no"   => checksinglequote($_POST[$postKey])
                    )) . ";";
                }
            }

        // Save Kontak Person Tambahan
        if (is_array($dataContacts)) {
            foreach ($dataContacts as $contact) {
                $contId = intval($contact->cont_id ?? 0);
                if ($contId > 0) {
                    $queryC .= updateQ("m_contact_person", array(
                        "name"     => checksinglequote($contact->name ?? ''),

                    ), "id = " . $contId) . ";";

                    if (!empty($contact->address)) {
                        $contAddrId = intval($contact->cont_address_id ?? 0);
                        if ($contAddrId > 0) {
                            $queryC .= updateQ("m_address", array("address" => checksinglequote($contact->address)), "id = " . $contAddrId) . ";";
                        } else {
                            $queryC .= insertQ("m_address", array(
                                "contact_person_id" => $contId,
                                "active"            => 'true',
                                "address"           => checksinglequote($contact->address)
                            )) . ";";
                        }
                    }

                    $subContacts = [
                        "email"  => ["id" => "cont_email_id", "type" => 1],
                        "mobile" => ["id" => "cont_mobile_id", "type" => 2],
                        "phone"  => ["id" => "cont_phone_id", "type" => 3]
                    ];

                    foreach ($subContacts as $sKey => $sCfg) {
                        if (!empty($contact->$sKey)) {
                            $subId = intval($contact->{$sCfg["id"]} ?? 0);
                            if ($subId > 0) {
                                $queryC .= updateQ("m_contact_no", array("contact_no" => checksinglequote($contact->$sKey)), "id = " . $subId) . ";";
                            } else {
                                $queryC .= insertQ("m_contact_no", array(
                                    "contact_person_id" => $contId,
                                    "contact_type"      => $sCfg["type"],
                                    "contact_no"        => checksinglequote($contact->$sKey)
                                )) . ";";
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    $queryC .= insertQ("m_contact_person", array(
                        "customer_id" => $customerId,
                        "name"        => checksinglequote($contact->name ?? ''),
                        "position"    => checksinglequote($contact->position ?? ''),
                        "remark"      => checksinglequote($contact->remark ?? '')
                    )) . ";";

                    if (!empty($contact->address)) {
                        $queryC .= insertQ("m_address", array(
                            "contact_person_id" => "currval('m_contact_person_id_seq'::regclass)",
                            "active"            => 'true',
                            "address"           => checksinglequote($contact->address)
                        )) . ";";
                    }

                    if (!empty($contact->email)) {
                        $queryC .= insertQ("m_contact_no", array(
                            "contact_type"      => 1,
                            "contact_person_id" => "currval('m_contact_person_id_seq'::regclass)",
                            "contact_no"        => checksinglequote($contact->email)
                        )) . ";";
                    }
                    if (!empty($contact->mobile)) {
                        $queryC .= insertQ("m_contact_no", array(
                            "contact_type"      => 2,
                            "contact_person_id" => "currval('m_contact_person_id_seq'::regclass)",
                            "contact_no"        => checksinglequote($contact->mobile)
                        )) . ";";
                    }
                    if (!empty($contact->phone)) {
                        $queryC .= insertQ("m_contact_no", array(
                            "contact_type"      => 3,
                            "contact_person_id" => "currval('m_contact_person_id_seq'::regclass)",
                            "contact_no"        => checksinglequote($contact->phone)
                        )) . ";";
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $db->cmdQ($queryC);
        echo $db->getResult();
    break;

    // ==========================================
    // 7. DELETE (Soft Delete Customer)
    // ==========================================
    case ('delete'):
        $deleteId = intval($_POST["id"] ?? 0);

        if ($deleteId > 0) {
            $table  = "m_customer";
            $data   = array("active" => 'false');
            $where  = "id = " . $deleteId;

            $queryC = updateQ($table, $data, $where) . ";";
            $db->cmdQ($queryC);
            echo $db->getResult();
        } else {
            echo json_encode([
                "success" => "false",
                "status"  => "Error",
                "message" => "ID Customer tidak valid untuk proses penghapusan."
            ]);
        }
    break;

    default:
        echo json_encode([
            "success" => "false",
            "status"  => "Error",
            "message" => "Task atau perintah tidak dikenali oleh sistem."
        ]);
    break;
}
?>

            SELECT 
                sm.bin_location_id,
                i.init as item_code,
                i.name as item_name,
                COALESCE(g.name, '-') AS grade_name,
                SUM(CASE WHEN sm.movement_type = 'IN' THEN sm.qty ELSE -sm.qty END) AS qty
            FROM stock_movements sm
            JOIN items i ON i.id = sm.item_id

            WHERE sm.bin_location_id::int = :bin_id::int
            GROUP BY sm.bin_location_id, i.init, i.name, g.name
            HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN sm.movement_type = 'IN' THEN sm.qty ELSE -sm.qty END) > 0
            ORDER BY i.init ASC

function SaveBinLocation($db, $id, $post) {
    $warehouseId = intval($post['warehouse_id'] ?? 0);
    $code        = trim($post['code'] ?? '');
    $name        = trim($post['name'] ?? '');
    $zone        = trim($post['zone'] ?? '');
    $rack        = trim($post['rack'] ?? '');
    $level       = trim($post['level'] ?? '');
    $active      = isset($post['active']) && ($post['active'] === '1' || $post['active'] === 'true' || $post['active'] === true);

    if ($warehouseId <= 0) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Gudang wajib dipilih.']);
        return;
    }
    if ($code === '') {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Kode Bin Location wajib diisi.']);
        return;
    }

    $sqlDup = "SELECT id FROM bin_locations WHERE warehouse_id = :warehouse_id AND code = :code";
    $paramsDup = ['warehouse_id' => $warehouseId, 'code' => $code];
    if ($id) {
        $sqlDup .= " AND id != :id";
        $paramsDup['id'] = $id;
    }
    $stmtDup = $db->prepare($sqlDup);
    $stmtDup->execute($paramsDup);
    if ($stmtDup->fetch()) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => "Kode '{$code}' sudah ada di gudang ini."]);
        return;
    }

    $data = [
        'warehouse_id' => $warehouseId,
        'code'         => $code,
        'name'         => $name !== '' ? $name : null,
        'zone'         => $zone !== '' ? $zone : null,
        'rack'         => $rack !== '' ? $rack : null,
        'level'        => $level !== '' ? $level : null,
        'active'       => $active ? 'true' : 'false'
    ];

    if ($id === null) {
        DbOrFail($db, $db->insert('bin_locations', $data), 'insert bin_locations');
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Bin Location '{$code}' berhasil ditambahkan."]);
    } else {
        DbOrFail($db, $db->update('bin_locations', $data, "id = {$id}"), 'update bin_locations');
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Bin Location '{$code}' berhasil diperbarui."]);
    }
}
exit;

## File: ./php-crud/purchase.planningCRD.php

<?php
/**
 * purchase_planningCRD.php
 * ============================================================
 * Laporan Purchase Planning: untuk tiap proyek, bandingkan Budget RAB
 * (rab_materials) vs yang SUDAH di-PO-kan (po_items.budget_item_id ->
 * rab_materials.id, tidak termasuk PO yang cancelled), supaya kelihatan
 * sisa material yang masih perlu dibeli.
 *
 * TIDAK menulis apa pun ke PO -- murni laporan. Tombol "Buat PO dari
 * sisa ini" di frontend hanya membawa data terpilih ke halaman PO
 * (m_po.php) lewat sessionStorage, PO-nya sendiri baru benar-benar
 * dibuat di sana.
 *
 * File related : - purchase_planning.php
 *                - purchase_planning.js
 * ============================================================
 */

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

session_start();
header('Content-Type: application/json');

$task = $_REQUEST['task'] ?? '';

function PgOrFail($result, $context = '') {
    if ($result === false) {
        throw new Exception(($context ? "[{$context}] " : '') . pg_last_error());
    }
    return $result;
}

try {
    switch ($task) {

        // ==========================================================
        // LIST PROJECTS -- Grid Utama (Proyek + Ringkasan Sisa Beli)
        // ==========================================================
        case 'list_projects':
            $searchQuery = trim($_REQUEST['query'] ?? '');
            $searchWhere = '';
            $searchParams = [];
            if ($searchQuery !== '') {
                $searchWhere = " WHERE p.name ILIKE $1";
                $searchParams[] = '%' . $searchQuery . '%';
            }

            $sql = "SELECT p.id, p.name,
                           COALESCE(agg.total_rab_count, 0) AS total_rab_count,
                           COALESCE(agg.material_count, 0) AS material_count,
                           COALESCE(agg.total_remaining_value, 0) AS total_remaining_value
                    FROM public.projects p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT r.project_id,
                               COUNT(*) AS total_rab_count,
                               COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (r.budget_qty - COALESCE(po_sum.qty_ordered,0)) > 0.0001) AS material_count,
                               SUM(GREATEST(r.budget_qty - COALESCE(po_sum.qty_ordered,0), 0) * r.unit_price) AS total_remaining_value
                        FROM rab_materials r
                        JOIN m_materials m ON m.id = r.material_id
                        LEFT JOIN materials mat ON mat.material_code = m.material_code
                        LEFT JOIN budget_items bi ON bi.project_id = r.project_id AND bi.material_id = mat.id
                        LEFT JOIN (
                            SELECT poi.budget_item_id, SUM(poi.qty) AS qty_ordered
                            FROM po_items poi
                            JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.id = poi.po_id
                            WHERE po.status <> 'Dibatalkan'
                            GROUP BY poi.budget_item_id
                        ) po_sum ON po_sum.budget_item_id = bi.id
                        GROUP BY r.project_id
                    ) agg ON agg.project_id = p.id
                    {$searchWhere}
                    ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC";
            $result = PgOrFail(pg_query_params($sql, $searchParams), 'list_projects');
            $rows = pg_fetch_all($result) ?: [];
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $rows, 'totalCount' => count($rows)]);
            break;

        // ==========================================================
        // LOAD PLANNING -- Detail Sisa Beli per Material utk 1 Proyek
        // ==========================================================
        case 'load_planning':
            $projectId = (int)($_REQUEST['project_id'] ?? 0);
            if ($projectId <= 0) throw new Exception('Proyek belum dipilih');

            $sql = "SELECT r.id AS rab_material_id, r.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit,
                           r.budget_qty, r.unit_price,
                           COALESCE(po_sum.qty_ordered, 0) AS qty_ordered,
                           GREATEST(r.budget_qty - COALESCE(po_sum.qty_ordered, 0), 0) AS qty_remaining,
                           (GREATEST(r.budget_qty - COALESCE(po_sum.qty_ordered, 0), 0) * r.unit_price) AS remaining_value
                    FROM rab_materials r
                    JOIN m_materials m ON m.id = r.material_id
                    LEFT JOIN materials mat ON mat.material_code = m.material_code
                    LEFT JOIN budget_items bi ON bi.project_id = r.project_id AND bi.material_id = mat.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT poi.budget_item_id, SUM(poi.qty) AS qty_ordered
                        FROM po_items poi
                        JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.id = poi.po_id
                        WHERE po.status <> 'Dibatalkan'
                        GROUP BY poi.budget_item_id
                    ) po_sum ON po_sum.budget_item_id = bi.id
                    WHERE r.project_id = $1
                    ORDER BY m.material_name";
            $result = PgOrFail(pg_query_params($sql, [$projectId]), 'load_planning');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => pg_fetch_all($result) ?: []]);
            break;

        default:
            throw new Exception('Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task));
    }
} catch (Exception $e) {
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
}

<?php
/*
  Document      : Profit & Loss (Rugi Laba) - CRUD & Report Handler
  Backend       : /proyek/php-crud/financial_profit_lossCRD.php
*/
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || empty($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Session expired. Silakan login kembali."]);
    exit;
}

$task   = $_POST['task'] ?? $_REQUEST['task'] ?? 'read_profit_loss';
$access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
$db     = new crud();

switch ($task) {

    // ==============================================================
    // READ: Data Periode
    case 'read_periods':
        $sql = "SELECT id, period_name, start_date, end_date FROM accounting_periods ORDER BY start_date DESC";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // READ: Laporan Rugi Laba Utama
    case 'read_profit_loss':
        $periodId = intval($_POST['period_id'] ?? $_REQUEST['period_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($periodId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode akuntansi wajib dipilih.']);
            exit;
        }

        $stmtP = $db->prepare("SELECT period_name, start_date, end_date FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id");
        $stmtP->execute(['id' => $periodId]);
        $period = $stmtP->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$period) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode tidak ditemukan.']);
            exit;
        }

        $sql = "
            SELECT c.id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type,
                   COALESCE(SUM(
                       CASE WHEN c.account_type = 'revenue' THEN l.credit - l.debit
                            WHEN c.account_type = 'expense' THEN l.debit - l.credit
                            ELSE 0 END
                   ), 0) AS amount
            FROM chart_of_accounts c
            LEFT JOIN journal_lines l ON l.account_id = c.id
            LEFT JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
                AND j.status IN ('posted', 'reversed')
                AND j.journal_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
            WHERE c.is_active = true
              AND c.account_type IN ('revenue', 'expense')
            GROUP BY c.id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type
            ORDER BY c.account_code ASC
        ";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([
            'start_date' => $period['start_date'],
            'end_date'   => $period['end_date']
        ]);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $revenues = [];
        $expenses = [];
        $totalRevenue = 0;
        $totalExpense = 0;

        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $amount = floatval($r['amount']);
            $item = [
                'id'           => $r['id'],
                'account_code' => $r['account_code'],
                'account_name' => $r['account_name'],
                'amount'       => $amount
            ];

            if ($r['account_type'] === 'revenue') {
                $revenues[] = $item;
                $totalRevenue += $amount;
            } else if ($r['account_type'] === 'expense') {
                $expenses[] = $item;
                $totalExpense += $amount;
            }
        }

        $netProfitLoss = $totalRevenue - $totalExpense;

        echo json_encode([
            'success'        => true,
            'period_name'    => $period['period_name'],
            'start_date'     => $period['start_date'],
            'end_date'       => $period['end_date'],
            'revenues'       => $revenues,
            'expenses'       => $expenses,
            'total_revenue'  => $totalRevenue,
            'total_expense'  => $totalExpense,
            'net_profit_loss'=> $netProfitLoss
        ]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // CREATE: Tambah Pemetaan Akun Baru (Pendapatan / Beban)
    case 'create':
        if ($access < 2) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $code = trim($_POST['account_code'] ?? '');
        $name = trim($_POST['account_name'] ?? '');
        $type = trim($_POST['account_type'] ?? '');

        if (empty($code) || empty($name) || !in_array($type, ['revenue', 'expense'])) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Kode, Nama, dan Tipe (revenue/expense) wajib diisi.']);
            exit;
        }

        $db->insert('chart_of_accounts', [
            'account_code' => $code,
            'account_name' => $name,
            'account_type' => $type,
            'is_active'    => true
        ]);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Akun Rugi Laba berhasil ditambahkan.']);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // UPDATE: Update Informasi Akun Rugi Laba
    case 'update':
        if ($access < 3) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id   = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        $code = trim($_POST['account_code'] ?? '');
        $name = trim($_POST['account_name'] ?? '');

        if ($id <= 0 || empty($code) || empty($name)) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID, Kode, dan Nama Akun tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }

        $db->update('chart_of_accounts', [
            'account_code' => $code,
            'account_name' => $name
        ], "id = {$id}");
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Akun Rugi Laba berhasil diperbarui.']);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // DELETE: Soft Delete Akun (Nonaktifkan Akun)
    case 'delete':
        if ($access < 4) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID Akun tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }

        $db->update('chart_of_accounts', ['is_active' => false], "id = {$id}");
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Akun berhasil dinonaktifkan.']);
        break;

    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task)]);
}

## File: ./php-crud/m.materialsCRD.php

<?php
/**
 * m.materialsCRD.php
 * Backend Controller CRUD Master Material (materials) PostgreSQL
 */

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

session_start();
header('Content-Type: application/json');

$task = $_REQUEST['task'] ?? '';

// Helper error handling PostgreSQL
function PgOrFail($result, $context = '') {
    if ($result === false) {
        throw new Exception(($context ? "[{$context}] " : '') . pg_last_error());
    }
    return $result;
}

try {
    switch ($task) {

        // ==========================================================
        // 1. LIST -- Load Data Grid
        // ==========================================================
        case 'list':
            $search = trim($_REQUEST['query'] ?? '');
            $where  = '1=1';
            $params = [];

            if ($search !== '') {
                $where .= " AND (material_code ILIKE $1 OR material_name ILIKE $1)";
                $params[] = '%' . $search . '%';
            }

            $sql = "SELECT id, material_code, material_name, unit, estimated_price, active, created_at
                    FROM materials
                    WHERE {$where}
                    ORDER BY material_name ASC";
                    
            $result = PgOrFail(pg_query_params($sql, $params), 'list');
            $rows = pg_fetch_all($result) ?: [];

            foreach ($rows as &$r) {
                $r['active'] = ($r['active'] === 't' || $r['active'] === 'true' || $r['active'] === true);
            }

            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $rows]);
            break;

        // ==========================================================
        // 2. READ EDIT -- Load Single Record
        // ==========================================================
        case 'read_edit':
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            $result = PgOrFail(pg_query_params(
                "SELECT id, material_code, material_name, unit, estimated_price, active
                 FROM materials WHERE id = $1",
                [$id]
            ), 'read_edit');
            
            $row = pg_fetch_assoc($result);
            if (!$row) throw new Exception('Data material tidak ditemukan');

            $row['active'] = ($row['active'] === 't' || $row['active'] === 'true' || $row['active'] === true);

            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $row]);
            break;

        // ==========================================================
        // 3. CREATE -- Insert Material Baru
        // ==========================================================
        case 'create':
            $code  = trim($_REQUEST['material_code'] ?? '');
            $name  = trim($_REQUEST['material_name'] ?? '');
            $unit  = trim($_REQUEST['unit'] ?? '');
            $price = (float)($_REQUEST['estimated_price'] ?? 0);

            // Parsing status active
            $rawActive = $_REQUEST['is_active'] ?? 'false';
            $active = ($rawActive === 'true' || $rawActive === 't' || $rawActive === '1' || $rawActive === true || $rawActive === 'on') ? 't' : 'f';

            if ($code === '') throw new Exception('Kode Material wajib diisi');
            if ($name === '') throw new Exception('Nama Material wajib diisi');
            if ($unit === '') throw new Exception('Satuan wajib diisi');

            pg_query('BEGIN');
            try {
                $result = PgOrFail(pg_query_params(
                    "INSERT INTO materials (material_code, material_name, unit, estimated_price, active)
                     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) RETURNING id",
                    [$code, $name, $unit, $price, $active]
                ), 'insert materials');
                
                $newId = pg_fetch_result($result, 0, 'id');
                pg_query('COMMIT');
            } catch (Exception $e) {
                @pg_query('ROLLBACK');
                if (stripos($e->getMessage(), 'duplicate') !== false || stripos($e->getMessage(), 'unique') !== false) {
                    throw new Exception("Kode Material '{$code}' sudah dipakai. Gunakan kode lain.");
                }
                throw $e;
            }

            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'id' => $newId, 'material_code' => $code]);
            break;

        // ==========================================================
        // 4. UPDATE -- Perbarui Data Material
        // ==========================================================
        case 'update':
            $id    = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            $code  = trim($_REQUEST['material_code'] ?? '');
            $name  = trim($_REQUEST['material_name'] ?? '');
            $unit  = trim($_REQUEST['unit'] ?? '');
            $price = (float)($_REQUEST['estimated_price'] ?? 0);

            // Parsing status active
            $rawActive = $_REQUEST['is_active'] ?? 'false';
            $active = ($rawActive === 'true' || $rawActive === 't' || $rawActive === '1' || $rawActive === true || $rawActive === 'on') ? 't' : 'f';

            if ($id <= 0) throw new Exception('ID Material tidak valid');
            if ($code === '') throw new Exception('Kode Material wajib diisi');
            if ($name === '') throw new Exception('Nama Material wajib diisi');
            if ($unit === '') throw new Exception('Satuan wajib diisi');

            pg_query('BEGIN');
            try {
                PgOrFail(pg_query_params(
                    "UPDATE materials
                     SET material_code = $1, material_name = $2, unit = $3, estimated_price = $4, active = $5
                     WHERE id = $6",
                    [$code, $name, $unit, $price, $active, $id]
                ), 'update materials');
                
                pg_query('COMMIT');
            } catch (Exception $e) {
                @pg_query('ROLLBACK');
                if (stripos($e->getMessage(), 'duplicate') !== false || stripos($e->getMessage(), 'unique') !== false) {
                    throw new Exception("Kode Material '{$code}' sudah dipakai oleh material lain.");
                }
                throw $e;
            }

            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'id' => $id]);
            break;

        // ==========================================================
        // 5. DELETE -- Soft Delete
        // ==========================================================
        case 'delete':
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            if ($id <= 0) throw new Exception('ID Material tidak valid');

            PgOrFail(pg_query_params(
                "UPDATE materials SET active = 'f' WHERE id = $1",
                [$id]
            ), 'soft delete materials');

            echo json_encode(['success' => true]);
            break;

        default:
            throw new Exception('Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task));
    }
} catch (Exception $e) {
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
}

<?php
/*
Document    : Master Proyek CRD (Backend API)
Description : Mengelola operasi Create, Read, Update, Delete untuk Master Data Proyek
              Terhubung ke tabel projects, clients, m_location, dan m_employee
File related: m_proyek.php, m_proyek.js
*/

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

$action =$_REQUEST['action'] ?? '';

switch ($action) {

    // =========================================================================
    // 1. READ LIST DATA PROYEK (GRID MAIN)
    // =========================================================================
    case 'read':
        try {
            $page  = isset($_POST['page']) ? intval($_POST['page']) : 1;
            $limit = isset($_POST['rows']) ? intval($_POST['rows']) : 20;
            $offset = ($page - 1) *$limit;
            $search =$_POST['search'] ?? '';

            $whereClause = "";
            $params = [];

            if (!empty($search)) {$whereClause = "WHERE p.name ILIKE :search OR c.name ILIKE :search OR p.status ILIKE :search";
                $params[':search'] = '\%' .$search . '%';
            }

            // Count total rows
            $stmtCount =$db->prepare("
                SELECT COUNT(*) 
                FROM projects p
                LEFT JOIN clients c ON p.client_id = c.id
                $whereClause
            ");
            $stmtCount->execute($params);
            $total =$stmtCount->fetchColumn();

            // Query Data Main Grid
            $stmtData =$db->prepare("
                SELECT 
                    p.id,
                    p.name AS project_name,
                    p.client_id,
                    c.name AS client_name,
                    p.location_id,
                    loc.name AS location_name,
                    p.location AS location_detail,
                    p.pic_id,
                    emp.employee_name AS pic_name,
                    p.start_date,
                    p.end_date,
                    p.budget,
                    p.contract_value,
                    p.spent,
                    p.progress,
                    p.status,
                    p.notes
                FROM projects p
                LEFT JOIN clients c ON p.client_id = c.id
                LEFT JOIN m_location loc ON p.location_id = loc.id
                LEFT JOIN m_employee emp ON p.pic_id = emp.id
                $whereClause
                ORDER BY p.id DESC
                LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset
            ");

            foreach ($params as$key => $val) {$stmtData->bindValue($key,$val);
            }
            $stmtData->bindValue(':limit', $limit, PDO::PARAM_INT);$stmtData->bindValue(':offset', $offset, PDO::PARAM_INT);$stmtData->execute();

            $rows =$stmtData->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            echo json_encode([
                'success' => true,
                'total'   => $total,
                'rows'    => $rows
            ]);
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    // =========================================================================
    // 2. READ LOOKUP / COMBOBOX DATA (CLIENTS, LOCATIONS, PICS)
    // =========================================================================
    case 'get_clients':
        $stmt =$db->query("SELECT id, name FROM clients ORDER BY name ASC");
        echo json_encode($stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC));
        break;

    case 'get_locations':
        $stmt =$db->query("SELECT id, name FROM m_location ORDER BY name ASC");
        echo json_encode($stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC));
        break;

    case 'get_pics':
        $stmt =$db->query("SELECT id, employee_name AS name FROM m_employee WHERE active = true ORDER BY employee_name ASC");
        echo json_encode($stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC));
        break;

    // =========================================================================
    // 3. CREATE & UPDATE (SAVE DATA)
    // =========================================================================
    case 'save':
        try {
            $id             =$_POST['id'] ?? null;
            $name           = trim($_POST['project_name'] ?? '');$client_id      = !empty($_POST['client_id']) ? intval($_POST['client_id']) : null;
            $location_id    = !empty($_POST['location_id']) ? intval($_POST['location_id']) : null;
            $location_detail= trim($_POST['location_detail'] ?? '');$pic_id         = !empty($_POST['pic_id']) ? intval($_POST['pic_id']) : null;
            $start_date     = !empty($_POST['start_date']) ?$_POST['start_date'] : null;
            $end_date       = !empty($_POST['end_date']) ?$_POST['end_date'] : null;

            $contract_value = !empty($_POST['contract_value']) ? floatval($_POST['contract_value']) : 0;
            $status         =$_POST['status'] ?? 'Berjalan';
            $notes          = trim($_POST['notes'] ?? '');

            if (empty($name)) {

                        name = :name,
                        client_id = :client_id,
                        location_id = :location_id,
                        location = :location_detail,
                        pic_id = :pic_id,
                        start_date = :start_date,
                        end_date = :end_date,
                        budget = :budget,
                        contract_value = :contract_value,
                        status = :status,
                        notes = :notes,
                        updated_at = NOW()
                    WHERE id = :id
                ");
                $stmt->bindValue(':id',$id, PDO::PARAM_INT);
            } else {
                // INSERT
                $stmt =$db->prepare("
                    INSERT INTO projects (
                        name, client_id, location_id, location, pic_id, 
                        start_date, end_date, budget, contract_value, status, notes, created_at, updated_at
                    ) VALUES (
                        :name, :client_id, :location_id, :location_detail, :pic_id, 
                        :start_date, :end_date, :budget, :contract_value, :status, :notes, NOW(), NOW()
                    )
                ");
            }

            $stmt->bindValue(':name', $name);$stmt->bindValue(':client_id', $client_id,$client_id ? PDO::PARAM_INT : PDO::PARAM_NULL);
            $stmt->bindValue(':location_id', $location_id,$location_id ? PDO::PARAM_INT : PDO::PARAM_NULL);
            $stmt->bindValue(':location_detail', $location_detail);$stmt->bindValue(':pic_id', $pic_id,$pic_id ? PDO::PARAM_INT : PDO::PARAM_NULL);
            $stmt->bindValue(':start_date', $start_date,$start_date ? PDO::PARAM_STR : PDO::PARAM_NULL);
            $stmt->bindValue(':end_date', $end_date,$end_date ? PDO::PARAM_STR : PDO::PARAM_NULL);
            $stmt->bindValue(':budget', $budget);$stmt->bindValue(':contract_value', $contract_value);$stmt->bindValue(':status', $status);$stmt->bindValue(':notes', $notes);

            $stmt->execute();

            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Data proyek berhasil disimpan.']);
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Gagal menyimpan data: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    // =========================================================================
    // 4. DELETE DATA PROYEK
    // =========================================================================
    case 'delete':
        try {
            $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);

            if ($id <= 0) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID tidak valid!']);
                exit;
            }

            // Cek constraint relasi (misal jika proyek sudah ada transaksi)
            $checkStmt =$db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_orders WHERE project_id = :id");
            $checkStmt->execute([':id' =>$id]);
            if ($checkStmt->fetchColumn() > 0) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Proyek tidak dapat dihapus karena sudah memiliki Purchase Order terpaut.']);
                exit;
            }

            $stmt =$db->prepare("DELETE FROM projects WHERE id = :id");
            $stmt->execute([':id' =>$id]);

            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Proyek berhasil dihapus.']);
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Gagal menghapus data: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Aksi tidak valid!']);
        break;
}

            case amend_name
                when 'init' then '[EDIT] - Init'
                when 'name' then '[EDIT] - Name'
                when 'description' then '[EDIT] - Description'
                when 'remark' then '[EDIT] - Remark'
                else amend_name
            end ::character varying(200) AS amend_name,
            before_amendment, after_amendment, user_name, user_time
        ";
        $where   = "tx_id::int = " . $id . " and table_name = 'm_color'";

        if ($id > 0) {
            $table = "m_color";
            $data = array(

                "name"        => checksinglequote($_POST["name"] ?? ''),
                "description" => checksinglequote($_POST["description"] ?? ''),
                "remark"      => checksinglequote($_POST["remark"] ?? ''),
            );
            $where = "id = " . $id;
            $db->update($table, $data, $where);
            echo $db->getResult();
        } else {
            echo json_encode(["success" => "false", "status" => "Error", "message" => "ID tidak valid untuk proses update."]);
        }
    break;

    case ('delete'):
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id > 0) {
            $table = "m_color";
            $where = "id = " . $id;
            $db->delete($table, $where);
            echo $db->getResult();
        } else {
            echo json_encode(["success" => "false", "status" => "Error", "message" => "ID tidak valid untuk proses penghapusan."]);
        }
    break;

    default:
        echo json_encode(["success" => "false", "status" => "Error", "message" => "Task tidak dikenali."]);
    break;
}
