## File: ./php-crud/generalledgerCRD.php
----------------------------------------
<?php
/*
  Document      : General Ledger - Report Handler
  Called from   : js/m.generalledger.js
  Note          : - Laporan read-only, TIDAK ada create/update/delete.
                  - Filter Akun & Periode OPSIONAL:
                      account_id kosong/0 -> tampilkan SEMUA akun (dikelompokkan)
                      period_id  kosong/0 -> tampilkan SEMUA histori (tanpa
                                             batas tanggal, saldo awal = 0)
                  - Hanya jurnal berstatus 'posted' ATAU 'reversed' yang
                    dihitung. Mencakup SEMUA reference_type.
                  - Saldo berjalan dihitung PER AKUN pakai window function
                    (PARTITION BY account_id), ditambah saldo awal per akun
                    (0 kalau periode tidak difilter).
*/
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || empty($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Session expired. Silakan login kembali."]);
    exit;
}

$task = $_POST['task'] ?? $_REQUEST['task'] ?? 'read_ledger';
$db   = new crud();

switch ($task) {

    // ==============================================================
    case 'read_accounts':
        $sql = "SELECT id, account_code, account_name, account_type
                FROM chart_of_accounts
                WHERE is_active = true
                ORDER BY account_code ASC";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'read_periods':
        $sql = "SELECT id, period_name, start_date, end_date FROM accounting_periods ORDER BY start_date DESC";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // Laporan utama -- filter account_id & period_id keduanya OPSIONAL
    case 'read_ledger':
        $accountId = intval($_POST['account_id'] ?? 0);
        $periodId  = intval($_POST['period_id'] ?? 0);

        $startDate = null;
        $endDate   = null;
        $periodName = 'Semua Periode';

        if ($periodId > 0) {
            $stmtP = $db->prepare("SELECT period_name, start_date, end_date FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtP->execute(['id' => $periodId]);
            $period = $stmtP->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$period) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode tidak ditemukan.']);
                exit;
            }
            $startDate  = $period['start_date'];
            $endDate    = $period['end_date'];
            $periodName = $period['period_name'];
        }

        $accountLabel = 'Semua Akun';
        if ($accountId > 0) {
            $stmtAcc = $db->prepare("SELECT account_code, account_name FROM chart_of_accounts WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtAcc->execute(['id' => $accountId]);
            $acc = $stmtAcc->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$acc) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akun tidak ditemukan.']);
                exit;
            }
            $accountLabel = $acc['account_code'] . ' - ' . $acc['account_name'];
        }

        // Bangun kondisi WHERE secara dinamis
        $conds  = ["j.status IN ('posted', 'reversed')"];
        $params = [];
        if ($accountId > 0) {
            $conds[] = "l.account_id = :acc";
            $params['acc'] = $accountId;
        }
        if ($startDate !== null) {
            $conds[] = "j.journal_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date";
            $params['start_date'] = $startDate;
            $params['end_date']   = $endDate;
        }
        $where = implode(' AND ', $conds);

        // Saldo awal per akun -- hanya relevan kalau periode difilter.
        // Kalau tidak difilter, seluruh histori sudah masuk ke query utama,
        // jadi saldo awal = 0 (tidak ada "sebelum" yang perlu diakumulasi).
        $openingSubquery = "0";
        if ($startDate !== null) {
            $openingCond = "l2.account_id = l.account_id AND j2.status IN ('posted','reversed') AND j2.journal_date < :ob_start_date";
            if ($accountId > 0) {
                $openingCond .= " AND l2.account_id = :ob_acc";
            }
            $openingSubquery = "(
                SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c2.account_type IN ('asset','expense') THEN l2.debit - l2.credit ELSE l2.credit - l2.debit END), 0)
                FROM journal_lines l2
                JOIN journal_entries j2 ON j2.id = l2.journal_id
                JOIN chart_of_accounts c2 ON c2.id = l2.account_id
                WHERE {$openingCond}
            )";
            $params['ob_start_date'] = $startDate;
            if ($accountId > 0) $params['ob_acc'] = $accountId;
        }

        $sql = "
            SELECT j.journal_date, j.ref_no, l.description AS line_desc, j.description AS header_desc,
                   l.debit, l.credit, l.account_id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type,
                   {$openingSubquery} AS opening_balance,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN c.account_type IN ('asset','expense') THEN l.debit - l.credit ELSE l.credit - l.debit END)
                     OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id ORDER BY j.journal_date, j.id, l.id
                           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_in_range
            FROM journal_lines l
            JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
            JOIN chart_of_accounts c ON c.id = l.account_id
            WHERE {$where}
            ORDER BY c.account_code ASC, j.journal_date ASC, j.id ASC, l.id ASC
        ";

        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $data = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $data[] = [
                'account_id'      => $r['account_id'],
                'account_code'    => $r['account_code'],
                'account_name'    => $r['account_name'],
                'account_label'   => $r['account_code'] . ' - ' . $r['account_name'],
                'journal_date'    => $r['journal_date'],
                'ref_no'      => $r['ref_no'],
                'description'     => $r['line_desc'] ?: $r['header_desc'],
                'debit'           => floatval($r['debit']),
                'credit'          => floatval($r['credit']),
                'balance'         => floatval($r['opening_balance']) + floatval($r['cum_in_range'])
            ];
        }

        echo json_encode([
            'success'      => true,
            'account_label'=> $accountLabel,
            'period_name'  => $periodName,
            'totalCount'   => count($data),
            'data'         => $data
        ]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task)]);
}

<?php
/**
 * grn00CRD.php
 * ============================================================
 * Backend untuk grn00.js (Proses GRN tanpa Simpan Warehouse).
 * Kontrak task: list_po_open, read_po_items, read,

function PgOrFail($result, $context = '') {
    if ($result === false) {
        throw new Exception(($context ? "[{$context}] " : '') . pg_last_error());
    }
    return $result;
}

function GetPoDtlTolerance($po_dtl_id, $po_qty, $exclude_grn_hdr_id = 0) {
    // Total Qty yang sudah diterima GRN lain untuk item PO ini
    $sql = "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty_received),0) AS received_other
            FROM grn_dtl 
            WHERE po_item_id = $1 AND grn_hdr_id <> $2";
    $res = pg_query_params($sql, [$po_dtl_id, (int)$exclude_grn_hdr_id]);
    PgOrFail($res, 'Gagal cek akumulasi qty GRN');
    $row = pg_fetch_assoc($res);
    $receivedOther = (float)($row['received_other'] ?? 0);

    $qtyMaxAllowed = round($po_qty * 1.10, 4);
    $qtyReceivableMax = max(0, $qtyMaxAllowed - $receivedOther);

    return [
        'others_qty'         => $receivedOther,
        'qty_max_allowed'    => $qtyMaxAllowed,
        'qty_receivable_max' => $qtyReceivableMax
    ];
}

try {
    switch ($task) {

        case 'list_po_open':
            // HANYA MENGAMBIL PO YANG MEMILIKI SISA QTY BELUM DI-GRN
            $sql = "SELECT p.id, p.po_number AS ref_no, p.po_date AS tx_date, 
                           p.supplier_id, 
                           COALESCE(sup.id, p.supplier_id) AS legacy_supplier_id, 
                           sup.name AS supplier_name
                    FROM purchase_orders p
                    LEFT JOIN m_suppliers sup ON sup.id = p.supplier_id
                    JOIN po_items pd ON pd.po_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT po_item_id, SUM(qty_received) AS total_rcv
                        FROM grn_dtl
                        GROUP BY po_item_id
                    ) g ON g.po_item_id = pd.id
                    WHERE p.status <> 'Selesai'
                    GROUP BY p.id, p.po_number, p.po_date, p.supplier_id, sup.id, sup.name
                    HAVING SUM(pd.qty) - COALESCE(SUM(g.total_rcv), 0) > 0.0001
                    ORDER BY p.po_date DESC";
            $result = pg_query($sql);
            PgOrFail($result, 'Gagal load daftar PO');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => pg_fetch_all($result) ?: []]);
            break;

        case 'read_po_items':
            $po_id  = (int)($_REQUEST['po_id'] ?? 0);
            $grn_id = (int)($_REQUEST['grn_id'] ?? 0);

            $sql = "SELECT pd.id AS po_dtl_id, pd.material_id AS item_id, pd.description AS item_name, 
                           pd.qty AS qty_ordered, pd.unit_price
                    FROM po_items pd
                    WHERE pd.po_id = $1
                    ORDER BY pd.id";
            $result = pg_query_params($sql, [$po_id]);
            PgOrFail($result, 'Gagal load detail PO');
            $rows = pg_fetch_all($result) ?: [];

            $data = [];
            foreach ($rows as $r) {
                $poQty = (float)$r['qty_ordered'];
                $tol   = GetPoDtlTolerance($r['po_dtl_id'], $poQty, $grn_id);

                // Cek apakah item ini milik GRN yang sedang diedit
                $ownResult = pg_query_params(
                    "SELECT qty_received, unit_cost FROM grn_dtl WHERE po_item_id = $1 AND grn_hdr_id = $2",
                    [$r['po_dtl_id'], $grn_id]
                );
                PgOrFail($ownResult, 'Gagal cek baris grn_dtl existing');
                $own = pg_fetch_assoc($ownResult);

                // Hitung sisa murni PO (PO_Qty - Received_Others)
                $sisaQtyPure = max(0, $poQty - $tol['others_qty']);

                // Sisa maksimal yang diizinkan (Toleransi 10%)
                $sisaQtyBolehditerima = $tol['qty_receivable_max'];

                // Jika Sisa Qty Murni <= 0 dan bukan dalam mode Edit item terkait, skip (jangan tampilkan)
                if ($sisaQtyPure <= 0.0001 && !$own) {
                    continue;
                }

                $data[] = [
                    'po_dtl_id'             => $r['po_dtl_id'],
                    'item_id'               => $r['item_id'],
                    'item_name'             => $r['item_name'],
                    'qty_ordered'           => $poQty,
                    'unit_price'            => (float)$r['unit_price'],
                    'qty_received'          => $tol['others_qty'],
                    'sisa_qty_po'           => $sisaQtyPure,
                    'qty_max_allowed'       => $tol['qty_max_allowed'],
                    'qty_receivable_max'    => $sisaQtyBolehditerima,
                    'qty_received_this_grn' => $own ? (float)$own['qty_received'] : $sisaQtyPure,
                    'unit_cost_this_grn'    => $own ? (float)$own['unit_cost'] : (float)$r['unit_price']
                ];
            }

            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data]);
            break;

        case 'read':
            $sql = "SELECT g.id, g.ref_no, g.grn_date, g.status, g.remark,
                           p.po_number AS po_ref_no, g.po_id, s.id AS supplier_id, s.name AS supplier_name,
                           (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty_received),0) FROM grn_dtl d WHERE d.grn_hdr_id = g.id) AS total_qty,
                           (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty_received * unit_cost),0) FROM grn_dtl d WHERE d.grn_hdr_id = g.id) AS total_amount
                    FROM grn_hdr g
                    LEFT JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.id = g.po_id
                    LEFT JOIN m_suppliers s ON s.id = g.supplier_id
                    ORDER BY g.grn_date DESC, g.id DESC";
            $result = pg_query($sql);
            PgOrFail($result, 'Gagal load daftar GRN');
            $all = pg_fetch_all($result) ?: [];
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($all), 'data' => $all]);
            break;

        case 'read_grn_items':
            $grn_id = (int)($_REQUEST['grn_id'] ?? 0);
            $sql = "SELECT item_name, qty_received AS qty, unit_cost AS unit_price
                    FROM grn_dtl WHERE grn_hdr_id = $1 ORDER BY id";
            $result = pg_query_params($sql, [$grn_id]);
            PgOrFail($result, 'Gagal load item GRN');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => pg_fetch_all($result) ?: []]);
            break;

        case 'read_edit':
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            $hdrResult = pg_query_params("SELECT * FROM grn_hdr WHERE id = $1", [$id]);
            PgOrFail($hdrResult, 'Gagal load GRN');
            $hdr = pg_fetch_assoc($hdrResult);
            if (!$hdr) throw new Exception('Data tidak ditemukan');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $hdr]);
            break;

        case 'create':
            $po_id       = (int)($_REQUEST['po_id'] ?? 0);
            $supplier_id = (int)($_REQUEST['supplier_id'] ?? 0);
            $grn_date    = $_REQUEST['grn_date'] ?? date('Y-m-d');
            $remark      = $_REQUEST['remark'] ?? null;
            $arrItems    = json_decode($_REQUEST['arrItems'] ?? '[]', true);
            $created_by  = $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? null;

            if (!$po_id) throw new Exception('PO belum dipilih');

            if (!$supplier_id) {
                $supRes = pg_query_params("SELECT supplier_id FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = $1", [$po_id]);
                if ($supRes && $supRow = pg_fetch_assoc($supRes)) {
                    $supplier_id = (int)$supRow['supplier_id'];
                }
            }

            if (!$supplier_id) throw new Exception('Supplier tidak ditemukan dari PO');
            if (empty($arrItems)) throw new Exception('Minimal 1 item harus diisi qty diterima');

            pg_query('BEGIN');

            $ref_no = CreateRefNo('grn_hdr', 'ref_no', 'GRN');

            $hdrResult = pg_query_params(
                "INSERT INTO grn_hdr (ref_no, grn_date, po_id, supplier_id, status, remark, created_by, created_at)
                 VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,'open',$5,$6,NOW()) RETURNING id",
                [$ref_no, $grn_date, $po_id, $supplier_id, $remark, $created_by]
            );
            PgOrFail($hdrResult, 'Gagal insert grn_hdr');
            $grn_hdr_id = pg_fetch_result($hdrResult, 0, 'id');

            InsertGrnItems($grn_hdr_id, $arrItems, 0);

            pg_query('COMMIT');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "GRN {$ref_no} berhasil disimpan.", 'id' => $grn_hdr_id, 'ref_no' => $ref_no]);
            break;

        case 'update':
            $id          = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            $po_id       = (int)($_REQUEST['po_id'] ?? 0);
            $supplier_id = (int)($_REQUEST['supplier_id'] ?? 0);
            $grn_date    = $_REQUEST['grn_date'] ?? date('Y-m-d');
            $remark      = $_REQUEST['remark'] ?? null;
            $arrItems    = json_decode($_REQUEST['arrItems'] ?? '[]', true);

            if (!$id) throw new Exception('GRN tidak valid');

            if (!$supplier_id && $po_id) {
                $supRes = pg_query_params("SELECT supplier_id FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = $1", [$po_id]);
                if ($supRes && $supRow = pg_fetch_assoc($supRes)) {
                    $supplier_id = (int)$supRow['supplier_id'];
                }
            }

            if (!$supplier_id) throw new Exception('Supplier belum dipilih');
            if (empty($arrItems)) throw new Exception('Minimal 1 item harus diisi qty diterima');

            pg_query('BEGIN');

            GuardNoWhReceiving($id, 'diedit');

            $delResult = pg_query_params("DELETE FROM grn_dtl WHERE grn_hdr_id = $1", [$id]);
            PgOrFail($delResult, 'Gagal hapus baris lama grn_dtl');

            $upd = pg_query_params(
                "UPDATE grn_hdr SET supplier_id = $1, grn_date = $2, remark = $3 WHERE id = $4",
                [$supplier_id, $grn_date, $remark, $id]
            );
            PgOrFail($upd, 'Gagal update grn_hdr');

            InsertGrnItems($id, $arrItems, $id);

            pg_query('COMMIT');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'GRN berhasil diupdate.', 'id' => $id]);
            break;

        case 'delete':
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            if (!$id) throw new Exception('GRN tidak valid');

            pg_query('BEGIN');

            GuardNoWhReceiving($id, 'dihapus');

            $delDtl = pg_query_params("DELETE FROM grn_dtl WHERE grn_hdr_id = $1", [$id]);
            PgOrFail($delDtl, 'Gagal hapus grn_dtl');

            $delHdr = pg_query_params("DELETE FROM grn_hdr WHERE id = $1", [$id]);
            PgOrFail($delHdr, 'Gagal hapus grn_hdr');

            pg_query('COMMIT');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'GRN berhasil dihapus.']);
            break;

        default:
            throw new Exception('Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task));
    }
} catch (Exception $e) {
    @pg_query('ROLLBACK');
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
}

function InsertGrnItems($grn_hdr_id, $arrItems, $exclude_grn_hdr_id) {
    $any_line = false;

    foreach ($arrItems as $it) {
        $qty = (float)($it['qty_received'] ?? 0);
        if ($qty <= 0) continue;

        $poResult = pg_query_params("SELECT qty AS po_qty FROM po_items WHERE id = $1", [$it['po_dtl_id']]);
        PgOrFail($poResult, 'Gagal cek qty PO');
        $poRow = pg_fetch_assoc($poResult);
        if (!$poRow) throw new Exception('Baris PO tidak ditemukan (po_dtl_id=' . $it['po_dtl_id'] . ')');

        $tol = GetPoDtlTolerance($it['po_dtl_id'], (float)$poRow['po_qty'], $exclude_grn_hdr_id);
        if ($qty > $tol['qty_receivable_max'] + 0.0001) {
            throw new Exception("Qty GRN untuk {$it['item_name']} ({$qty}) melebihi batas toleransi +10% PO (sisa maksimal: " . round($tol['qty_receivable_max'], 4) . ")");
        }

        $dtlResult = pg_query_params(
            "INSERT INTO grn_dtl (grn_hdr_id, po_item_id, item_id, item_name, qty_received, unit_cost, remark)
             VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7)",
            [
                $grn_hdr_id, $it['po_dtl_id'], $it['item_id'], $it['item_name'],
                $qty, $it['unit_cost'], $it['remark'] ?? null
            ]
        );
        PgOrFail($dtlResult, 'Gagal insert grn_dtl');

        $any_line = true;
    }

    if (!$any_line) {
        throw new Exception('Tidak ada baris dengan qty > 0');
    }
}

function GuardNoWhReceiving($grn_hdr_id, $actionLabel) {
    $chkResult = pg_query_params(
        "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.qty_received),0) AS total_wh
         FROM wh_receiving_dtl d
         JOIN wh_receiving_hdr h ON h.id = d.wh_receiving_hdr_id AND h.status = 'posted'
         JOIN grn_dtl gd ON gd.id = d.grn_dtl_id
         WHERE gd.grn_hdr_id = $1",
        [$grn_hdr_id]
    );
    PgOrFail($chkResult, 'Gagal cek qty yang sudah di-WH Rcv');
    $chk = pg_fetch_assoc($chkResult);
    if ((float)$chk['total_wh'] > 0) {
        throw new Exception("GRN tidak bisa {$actionLabel} -- sudah ada WH Rcv terkait. Reverse WH Rcv-nya dulu.");
    }
}

$offset      = isset($_POST["start"]) ? intval($_POST["start"]) : 0;

    // ==========================================
    case ('read'):

        $searchSQL = $sResult["searchSQL"];

            '' as password, '' as confirm_password,
            e.employee_name, e.gender, e.from_date, 
            d.location_init||' ~ '||d.department_name as department_name, 
            d.status_name
        ";

        $table = "
            m_user_system s
            left join m_employee e on e.id = s.employee_id
            left join view_employee_depart_status d on coalesce(d.id, 0) = coalesce(e.id, 0)
        ";

        $where = "1=1 " . $searchSQL;
        $order = "e.employee_name ASC";

        $db->select($table, $fields, $where, $order, $limit, $offset);
        echo $db->getResult();
        break;

    // ==========================================
    // 2. READ DETAIL GRID (Rincian Hak Akses Menu User)
    // ==========================================
    case ("read_detail"):
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? $_POST['user_id'] ?? $_REQUEST['id'] ?? $_REQUEST['user_id'] ?? 0);

        $fields = "
            u.id, u.form_id, u.access_level, u.user_id,
            fr.group_id, fr.seq, coalesce(fr.title,'') form_name, coalesce(fr.remark,'') remark,
            g.name as group_name, g.seq as group_seq, 'true' as active
        ";

        $table = "
            m_user_access_menu u
            left join m_form_name fr on fr.id = u.form_id
            left join (
                select id, name, coalesce(remark,'') remark, seq
                from (
                    (select d.id, h.name||'/'||d.name as name, d.remark, d.seq
                    from m_form_group d
                    left join (
                        select name, seq from m_form_group where substring(seq,3,2)='00'
                    ) h on substring(h.seq,1,2)=substring(d.seq,1,2)
                    where substring(d.seq,3,2)<>'00' and substring(d.seq,1,2)<>'00')
                    union
                    (select h.id, h.name, h.remark, seq
                    from m_form_group h
                    where substring(seq,3,2)='00' and substring(seq,1,2)<>'00')
                ) data
                order by seq
            ) g on g.id = fr.group_id
        ";

        $where = "u.user_id = " . $id;
        $order = "g.seq ASC, fr.seq ASC";

        $db->select($table, $fields, $where, $order);
        echo $db->getResult();
        break;

    // ==========================================
    // 3. READ EDIT (Load Single Record untuk Dialog Edit)
    // ==========================================
    case ("read_edit"):
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? $_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);

        $fields = "
            s.id, s.login_name, s.employee_id, s.employee_id as name, s.active,
            '' as password, '' as confirm_password,
            e.employee_name, e.gender, e.from_date, 
            d.department_name, d.status_name
        ";

        $table = "
            m_user_system s
            left join m_employee e on e.id = s.employee_id
            left join view_employee_depart_status d on coalesce(d.id, 0) = coalesce(e.id, 0)
        ";

        $where = "s.id = " . $id;

        $db->select($table, $fields, $where);
        echo $db->getResult();
        break;

    // ==========================================
    // 4. ADD FORM (Load Daftar Form Pilihan)
    // ==========================================
    case ('addform'):
        $field = "f.id form_id, g.name as group_name, f.title form_name, f.remark, 1 as access_level, 'true' as active";
        $cleanItemNum = str_replace("'", "", $CheckItemNum);

        $table = "
            m_form_name f
            left join (
                select id, name, coalesce(remark,'') remark, seq
                from (
                    (select d.id, h.name||' -- '||d.name as name, d.remark, d.seq
                    from m_form_group d
                    left join (
                        select name, seq from m_form_group where substring(seq,3,2)='00'
                    ) h on substring(h.seq,1,2)=substring(d.seq,1,2)
                    where substring(d.seq,3,2)<>'00' and substring(d.seq,1,2)<>'00')
                    union
                    (select h.id, h.name, h.remark, seq
                    from m_form_group h
                    where substring(seq,3,2)='00' and substring(seq,1,2)<>'00')
                ) data
            ) g on g.id = f.group_id
        ";

        $where = "f.id <> all (array" . $cleanItemNum . ")";
        if (!empty($searchField) && trim($searchField) != "") {
            $where .= " " . $searchField;
        }

        $orderBy = "g.name ASC, f.seq ASC";

        $db->select($table, $field, $where, $orderBy);
        $result = $db->getResult();
        
        if (empty($result) || trim($result) == "") {
            echo json_encode(array("totalRecord" => 0, "data" => array()));
        } else {
            echo $result;
        }
        break;

    // ==========================================
    // 5. CREATE (Tambah User Baru)
    // ==========================================
    case ('create'):
    case ('add'):
        $employeeId = intval($_POST["employee_id"] ?? $_POST["name"] ?? 0);

        // Validasi Foreign Key Karyawan
        if ($employeeId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode([
                "success" => "false", 
                "status"  => "Error", 
                "message" => "Gagal: Pilih Karyawan (Name) yang valid terlebih dahulu!"
            ]);
            exit;
        }

        $queryC = '';
        $table  = "m_user_system";
        $data   = array(
            "login_name"  => checksinglequote($_POST["login_name"] ?? ''),
            "employee_id" => $employeeId,
            "password"    => EncodeData($_POST["password"] ?? ''),
            "active"      => ($_POST["u_active"] === 'true' || $_POST["active"] === 'true') ? 'true' : 'false'
        );
        $queryC .= insertQ($table, $data) . ";";

        $table = "m_user_login_status";
        $data  = array("user_id" => "currval('m_user_system_id_seq'::regclass)");
        $queryC .= insertQ($table, $data) . ";";

        // Insert Detail Hak Akses Menu (baris dari gridEditor saat New User)
        $formAccessPayload = $_POST['form_access'] ?? $_POST['arrForm'] ?? null;

        if (!empty($formAccessPayload)) {
            // Bersihkan quote escape dari ExtJS
            $cleanJson = stripslashes($formAccessPayload);
            $dataForm  = json_decode($cleanJson, true);

            if (is_array($dataForm) && count($dataForm) > 0) {
                foreach ($dataForm as $row) {
                    $formId    = intval($row['form_id'] ?? 0);
                    $accessLvl = intval($row['access_level'] ?? 1);

                    if ($formId > 0) {
                        $tableD = "m_user_access_menu";
                        $dataD  = array(
                            "user_id"      => "currval('m_user_system_id_seq'::regclass)",
                            "form_id"      => $formId,
                            "access_level" => $accessLvl
                        );
                        $queryC .= insertQ($tableD, $dataD) . ";";
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $db->cmdQ($queryC);
        echo $db->getResult();
        break;

    // ==========================================
    // 6. UPDATE (Simpan Header User & Detail Hak Akses)
    // ==========================================
    case ('update'):
    case ('edit'):
        $queryC = '';
        $userId = intval($_POST['user_id'] ?? $_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        $employeeId = intval($_POST["employee_id"] ?? $_POST["name"] ?? 0);

        if ($userId > 0) {
            // Proteksi Fallback: Ambil employee_id dari DB jika nilainya 0
            if ($employeeId <= 0) {
                $checkStmt = $db->prepare("SELECT employee_id FROM m_user_system WHERE id = :id");
                $checkStmt->execute(['id' => $userId]);
                $existRow = $checkStmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if ($existRow && !empty($existRow['employee_id'])) {
                    $employeeId = intval($existRow['employee_id']);
                }
            }

            if ($employeeId <= 0) {
                echo json_encode([
                    "success" => "false", 
                    "status"  => "Error", 
                    "message" => "Gagal Simpan: ID Karyawan tidak terdeteksi (Foreign Key Violation)."
                ]);
                exit;
            }

            // A. Update Master Header User System
            $table = "m_user_system";
            $data  = array(
                "login_name"  => checksinglequote($_POST["login_name"] ?? ''),
                "employee_id" => $employeeId,
                "active"      => ($_POST["u_active"] === 'true' || $_POST["u_active"] === true || $_POST["active"] === 'true') ? 'true' : 'false'
            );
            
            if (!empty($_POST["password"])) {
                $data["password"] = EncodeData($_POST["password"]);
            }

            $where = "id = " . $userId;
            $queryC .= updateQ($table, $data, $where) . ";";

            // B. Update / Insert Detail Hak Akses Menu
            $formAccessPayload = $_POST['form_access'] ?? $_POST['arrForm'] ?? null;

            if (!empty($formAccessPayload)) {
                // Bersihkan quote escape dari ExtJS
                $cleanJson = stripslashes($formAccessPayload);
                $dataForm  = json_decode($cleanJson, true);

                if (is_array($dataForm) && count($dataForm) > 0) {
                    $keepAccessIds = array();

                    foreach ($dataForm as $row) {
                        $accessId  = intval($row['id'] ?? 0);
                        $formId    = intval($row['form_id'] ?? 0);
                        $accessLvl = intval($row['access_level'] ?? 1);

                        if ($accessId > 0) {
                            // Update Detail Hak Akses Eksisting
                            $keepAccessIds[] = $accessId;
                            $tableD = "m_user_access_menu";
                            $dataD  = array("access_level" => $accessLvl);
                            $whereD = "id = " . $accessId;
                            $queryC .= updateQ($tableD, $dataD, $whereD) . ";";
                        } else if ($formId > 0) {
                            // Insert Detail Hak Akses Baru
                            // PENTING: dieksekusi langsung (di luar batch $queryC) dengan RETURNING id,
                            // supaya id barunya diketahui dan bisa dimasukkan ke $keepAccessIds SEBELUM
                            // statement DELETE cleanup di bawah dibangun. Kalau tidak, baris baru ini
                            // akan langsung ikut terhapus oleh DELETE ... id NOT IN (...) pada batch yang sama.
                            $insStmt = $db->prepare(
                                "INSERT INTO m_user_access_menu (user_id, form_id, access_level) VALUES (:uid, :fid, :lvl) RETURNING id"
                            );
                            $insStmt->execute([
                                'uid' => $userId,
                                'fid' => $formId,
                                'lvl' => $accessLvl
                            ]);
                            $newAccessId = $insStmt->fetchColumn();
                            if ($newAccessId) {
                                $keepAccessIds[] = intval($newAccessId);
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Hapus Detail Menu yang Dibuang/Dihapus pada Grid Editor
                    if (!empty($keepAccessIds)) {
                        $idsString = implode(',', $keepAccessIds);
                        $queryC .= "DELETE FROM m_user_access_menu WHERE user_id = " . $userId . " AND id NOT IN (" . $idsString . ");";
                    }
                }
            }

            $db->cmdQ($queryC);
            echo $db->getResult();
        } else {
            echo json_encode([
                "success" => "false", 
                "status"  => "Error", 
                "message" => "ID User tidak valid untuk proses update."
            ]);
        }
        break;

    // ==========================================
    // 7. DELETE (Hapus User System)
    // ==========================================
    case ('delete'):
        $deleteId = intval($_POST['id'] ?? $_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);

        if ($deleteId > 0) {
            $table  = "m_user_system";
            $data   = array("active" => 'false');
            $where  = "id = " . $deleteId;
            $queryC = updateQ($table, $data, $where) . ";";

            $db->cmdQ($queryC);
            echo $db->getResult();
        } else {
            echo json_encode([
                "success" => "false", 
                "status"  => "Error", 
                "message" => "ID User tidak valid untuk proses penghapusan."
            ]);
        }
        break;

    default:
        echo json_encode([
            "success" => "false", 
            "status"  => "Error", 
            "message" => "Perintah task '" . htmlspecialchars($task) . "' tidak valid."
        ]);
        break;
}
?>

## File: ./php-crud/balancesheetCRD.php

<?php
/*
  Document      : Balance Sheet (Neraca) - CRUD & Report Handler
  Backend       : /proyek/php-crud/financial_balance_sheetCRD.php
*/
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || empty($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Session expired. Silakan login kembali."]);
    exit;
}

$task   = $_POST['task'] ?? $_REQUEST['task'] ?? 'read_balance_sheet';
$access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
$db     = new crud();

switch ($task) {

    // ==============================================================
    // READ: Data Periode
    case 'read_periods':
        $sql = "SELECT id, period_name, start_date, end_date FROM accounting_periods ORDER BY start_date DESC";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // READ: Laporan Neraca Utama
    case 'read_balance_sheet':
        $periodId = intval($_POST['period_id'] ?? $_REQUEST['period_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($periodId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode akuntansi wajib dipilih.']);
            exit;
        }

        $stmtP = $db->prepare("SELECT period_name, end_date FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id");
        $stmtP->execute(['id' => $periodId]);
        $period = $stmtP->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$period) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode tidak ditemukan.']);
            exit;
        }
        $asOfDate = $period['end_date'];

        // Saldo Akun Riil
        $sql = "
            SELECT c.id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type,
                   COALESCE(SUM(
                       CASE WHEN c.account_type = 'asset' THEN l.debit - l.credit
                            WHEN c.account_type IN ('liability', 'equity') THEN l.credit - l.debit
                            ELSE 0 END
                   ), 0) AS balance
            FROM chart_of_accounts c
            LEFT JOIN journal_lines l ON l.account_id = c.id
            LEFT JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
                AND j.status IN ('posted', 'reversed')
                AND j.journal_date <= :as_of_date
            WHERE c.is_active = true
              AND c.account_type IN ('asset', 'liability', 'equity')
            GROUP BY c.id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type
            ORDER BY c.account_code ASC
        ";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(['as_of_date' => $asOfDate]);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        // Laba/Rugi Berjalan s/d $asOfDate
        $sqlPL = "
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
                       CASE WHEN c.account_type = 'revenue' THEN l.credit - l.debit
                            WHEN c.account_type = 'expense' THEN l.debit - l.credit
                            ELSE 0 END
                   ), 0) AS net_profit
            FROM chart_of_accounts c
            JOIN journal_lines l ON l.account_id = c.id
            JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
            WHERE j.status IN ('posted', 'reversed')
              AND j.journal_date <= :as_of_date
              AND c.account_type IN ('revenue', 'expense')
        ";
        $stmtPL = $db->prepare($sqlPL);
        $stmtPL->execute(['as_of_date' => $asOfDate]);
        $currentEarnings = floatval($stmtPL->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['net_profit'] ?? 0);

        $assets      = [];
        $liabilities = [];
        $equities    = [];
        
        $totalAsset     = 0;
        $totalLiability = 0;
        $totalEquity    = 0;

        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $balance = floatval($r['balance']);
            $item = [
                'id'           => $r['id'],
                'account_code' => $r['account_code'],
                'account_name' => $r['account_name'],
                'balance'      => $balance
            ];

            if ($r['account_type'] === 'asset') {
                $assets[]   = $item;
                $totalAsset += $balance;
            } else if ($r['account_type'] === 'liability') {
                $liabilities[]   = $item;
                $totalLiability += $balance;
            } else if ($r['account_type'] === 'equity') {
                $equities[]   = $item;
                $totalEquity += $balance;
            }
        }

        if (abs($currentEarnings) > 0.001) {
            $equities[] = [
                'id'           => 0,
                'account_code' => '-',
                'account_name' => 'Laba / (Rugi) Periode Berjalan',
                'balance'      => $currentEarnings
            ];
            $totalEquity += $currentEarnings;
        }

        $totalLiabilityEquity = $totalLiability + $totalEquity;

        echo json_encode([
            'success'                => true,
            'period_name'            => $period['period_name'],
            'as_of_date'             => $asOfDate,
            'assets'                 => $assets,
            'liabilities'            => $liabilities,
            'equities'               => $equities,
            'total_asset'            => $totalAsset,
            'total_liability'        => $totalLiability,
            'total_equity'           => $totalEquity,
            'total_liability_equity' => $totalLiabilityEquity,
            'is_balanced'            => abs($totalAsset - $totalLiabilityEquity) < 0.01
        ]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // CREATE: Tambah Akun Neraca Baru (Asset / Liability / Equity)
    case 'create':
        if ($access < 2) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $code = trim($_POST['account_code'] ?? '');
        $name = trim($_POST['account_name'] ?? '');
        $type = trim($_POST['account_type'] ?? '');

        if (empty($code) || empty($name) || !in_array($type, ['asset', 'liability', 'equity'])) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Kode, Nama, dan Tipe (asset/liability/equity) wajib diisi.']);
            exit;
        }

        $db->insert('chart_of_accounts', [
            'account_code' => $code,
            'account_name' => $name,
            'account_type' => $type,
            'is_active'    => true
        ]);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Akun Neraca berhasil ditambahkan.']);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // UPDATE: Update Akun Neraca
    case 'update':
        if ($access < 3) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id   = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        $code = trim($_POST['account_code'] ?? '');
        $name = trim($_POST['account_name'] ?? '');

        if ($id <= 0 || empty($code) || empty($name)) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID, Kode, dan Nama Akun tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }

        $db->update('chart_of_accounts', [
            'account_code' => $code,
            'account_name' => $name
        ], "id = {$id}");
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Akun Neraca berhasil diperbarui.']);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // DELETE: Soft Delete Akun Neraca
    case 'delete':
        if ($access < 4) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID Akun tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }

        $db->update('chart_of_accounts', ['is_active' => false], "id = {$id}");
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Akun Neraca berhasil dinonaktifkan.']);
        break;

    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task)]);
}

<?php
/*
  Document      : Fiscal Period - CRUD Handler
  Called from   : js/m.fiscalperiod.js
  Note          : Mengelola tabel accounting_periods (bukan fiscal_periods --
                  tabel itu sempat dibuat keliru & sudah di-drop). Struktur
                  aslinya lebih simpel: id, period_name, start_date, end_date,
                  is_closed -- tanpa period_year/period_month terpisah.
*/
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || empty($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Session expired. Silakan login kembali."]);

$task = $_POST['task'] ?? $_REQUEST['task'] ?? 'read';

switch ($task) {

    // ==============================================================
    case 'read':

        $sql = "
            SELECT id, period_name, start_date, end_date, is_closed
            FROM accounting_periods
            WHERE {$where}
            ORDER BY start_date DESC
            LIMIT " . intval($limit);

        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'status' => 'Success', 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'read_edit':
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id");
        $stmt->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => (bool)$row, 'data' => $row ?: new stdClass()]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // Combo utk dropdown pilih periode di modul Journal Entry dkk
    // (hanya periode yg masih terbuka)
    case 'read_open':
        $sql = "SELECT id, period_name FROM accounting_periods WHERE is_closed = false ORDER BY start_date";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'create':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 2) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }

        $periodName = trim($_POST['period_name'] ?? '');
        $startDate  = trim($_POST['start_date'] ?? '');
        $endDate    = trim($_POST['end_date'] ?? '');

        if (empty($periodName) || empty($startDate) || empty($endDate)) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Nama periode, tanggal mulai, dan tanggal selesai wajib diisi.']);
            exit;
        }
        if (strtotime($endDate) < strtotime($startDate)) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Tanggal selesai tidak boleh sebelum tanggal mulai.']);
            exit;
        }

        $stmtChk = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM accounting_periods WHERE period_name = :name");
        $stmtChk->execute(['name' => $periodName]);
        if ($stmtChk->fetch()) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Periode dengan nama ini sudah ada.']);
            exit;
        }

        $db->insert('accounting_periods', [
            'period_name' => $periodName,
            'start_date'  => $startDate,
            'end_date'    => $endDate,
            'is_closed'   => false
        ]);
        echo $db->getResult();
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // Tutup Buku -- generate jurnal penutup (pindahkan saldo Pendapatan/
    // Beban periode ini ke akun Laba Ditahan), lalu kunci periode.
    case 'close':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 4) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Hanya akses tertinggi yang boleh menutup periode.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);

        $stmtPer = $db->prepare("SELECT period_name, start_date, end_date, is_closed FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id");
        $stmtPer->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $period = $stmtPer->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$period) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Periode tidak ditemukan.']);
            exit;
        }
        if ($period['is_closed']) {

            exit;
        }

        // 1. Wajib: tidak boleh ada jurnal Draft yang belum diselesaikan di periode ini
        $stmtDraft = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM journal_entries WHERE period_id = :id AND status = 'draft'");
        $stmtDraft->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $draftCount = intval($stmtDraft->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['cnt']);
        if ($draftCount > 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => "Tidak bisa tutup buku: masih ada {$draftCount} jurnal berstatus Draft di periode ini. Post atau hapus dulu sebelum menutup periode."]);
            exit;
        }

        // 2. Cari akun Laba Ditahan (Retained Earnings) -- coba kode 3200 dulu,
        //    fallback cari berdasarkan nama kalau kode berbeda.
        $stmtRE = $db->prepare("SELECT id, account_name FROM chart_of_accounts WHERE account_code = '3200' AND is_active = true LIMIT 1");
        $stmtRE->execute();
        $reAccount = $stmtRE->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$reAccount) {
            $stmtRE2 = $db->prepare("SELECT id, account_name FROM chart_of_accounts WHERE account_type = 'equity' AND account_name ILIKE '%laba ditahan%' AND is_active = true LIMIT 1");
            $stmtRE2->execute();
            $reAccount = $stmtRE2->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        }
        if (!$reAccount) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Akun Laba Ditahan tidak ditemukan (cari kode 3200 atau nama mengandung "Laba Ditahan"). Buat akun ini dulu di Chart of Accounts sebelum tutup buku.']);
            exit;
        }
        $retainedEarningsId = $reAccount['id'];

        // 3. Hitung saldo Pendapatan & Beban KHUSUS periode ini
        $sqlIS = "
            SELECT c.id, c.account_type,
                   COALESCE(SUM(
                       CASE WHEN c.account_type = 'revenue' THEN l.credit - l.debit
                            ELSE l.debit - l.credit END
                   ), 0) AS amount
            FROM chart_of_accounts c
            JOIN journal_lines l ON l.account_id = c.id
            JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
                AND j.status IN ('posted', 'reversed')
                AND j.journal_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
            WHERE c.is_active = true AND c.account_type IN ('revenue', 'expense')
            GROUP BY c.id, c.account_type
            HAVING COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.account_type = 'revenue' THEN l.credit - l.debit ELSE l.debit - l.credit END), 0) != 0
        ";
        $stmtIS = $db->prepare($sqlIS);
        $stmtIS->execute(['start_date' => $period['start_date'], 'end_date' => $period['end_date']]);
        $isRows = $stmtIS->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $closingLines = [];
        $revenueTotal = 0;
        $expenseTotal = 0;
        foreach ($isRows as $r) {
            $amt = floatval($r['amount']);
            if ($r['account_type'] === 'revenue') {
                // Nolkan revenue: DEBIT sejumlah saldo kreditnya
                $closingLines[] = ['account_id' => $r['id'], 'debit' => $amt, 'credit' => 0];
                $revenueTotal += $amt;
            } else {
                // Nolkan expense: KREDIT sejumlah saldo debitnya
                $closingLines[] = ['account_id' => $r['id'], 'debit' => 0, 'credit' => $amt];
                $expenseTotal += $amt;
            }
        }

        $netIncome = $revenueTotal - $expenseTotal;
        $closingRefNo = null;

        // Kalau tidak ada aktivitas Pendapatan/Beban sama sekali di periode ini,
        // tidak perlu bikin jurnal penutup -- langsung kunci periode saja.
        if (!empty($closingLines)) {
            // Baris penyeimbang ke Laba Ditahan
            if ($netIncome >= 0) {
                $closingLines[] = ['account_id' => $retainedEarningsId, 'debit' => 0, 'credit' => $netIncome];
            } else {
                $closingLines[] = ['account_id' => $retainedEarningsId, 'debit' => abs($netIncome), 'credit' => 0];
            }

            // Verifikasi balance sebelum insert (jaga-jaga)
            $sumDebit = array_sum(array_column($closingLines, 'debit'));
            $sumCredit = array_sum(array_column($closingLines, 'credit'));
            if (abs($sumDebit - $sumCredit) > 0.01) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Perhitungan jurnal penutup tidak balance, tutup buku dibatalkan. Hubungi administrator.']);
                exit;
            }

            $closingRefNo = CreateRefNo('journal_entries', 'ref_no', 'JCL');
            $db->insert('journal_entries', [
                'ref_no'         => $closingRefNo,
                'journal_date'   => $period['end_date'],
                'period_id'      => $id,
                'reference_type' => 'closing_entry',
                'reference_id'   => 0,
                'description'    => 'Jurnal Penutup - ' . $period['period_name'],
                'status'         => 'posted',
                'posted_by'      => $_SESSION['user_id'],
                'posted_at'      => date('Y-m-d H:i:s')
            ]);

            $stmtNewId = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM journal_entries WHERE ref_no = :no");
            $stmtNewId->execute(['no' => $closingRefNo]);
            $closingJournalId = $stmtNewId->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['id'] ?? null;

            if ($closingJournalId) {
                foreach ($closingLines as $l) {
                    $db->insert('journal_lines', [
                        'journal_id'  => $closingJournalId,
                        'account_id'  => $l['account_id'],
                        'debit'       => $l['debit'],
                        'credit'      => $l['credit'],
                        'description' => 'Tutup buku ' . $period['period_name']
                    ]);
                }
            }
        }

        // 4. Kunci periode
        $db->update('accounting_periods', ['is_closed' => true], "id = {$id}");

        $msg = $closingRefNo
            ? "Periode berhasil ditutup. Jurnal penutup: {$closingRefNo} (Laba/Rugi periode: " . number_format($netIncome, 2, ',', '.') . ")"
            : "Periode berhasil ditutup. Tidak ada aktivitas Pendapatan/Beban di periode ini, jurnal penutup tidak diperlukan.";
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => $msg]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'reopen':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 4) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Hanya akses tertinggi yang boleh membuka kembali periode.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);

        $stmtChk = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM journal_entries WHERE period_id = :id AND reference_type = 'closing_entry' AND status = 'posted'");
        $stmtChk->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $hasClosing = intval($stmtChk->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['cnt']) > 0;

        $db->update('accounting_periods', ['is_closed' => false], "id = {$id}");

        $msg = 'Periode berhasil dibuka kembali.';
        if ($hasClosing) {
            $msg .= ' PERHATIAN: periode ini punya jurnal penutup yang sudah posting -- kalau mau input jurnal baru lagi di periode ini, reverse dulu jurnal penutupnya lewat menu Journal Entry supaya tidak double-hitung Laba Ditahan saat tutup buku berikutnya.';
        }
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => $msg]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'delete':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 4) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);

        $stmtChk = $db->prepare("SELECT is_closed FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id");
        $stmtChk->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $row = $stmtChk->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if ($row && $row['is_closed']) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Periode yang sudah ditutup tidak boleh dihapus.']);
            exit;
        }

        $db->query("DELETE FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = {$id}");
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Periode berhasil dihapus.']);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task)]);
}

## File: ./php-crud/invoiceCRD.php

<?php

            FROM proyekoices i

        $stmt = $db->query($sql);

    // ==============================================================
    case 'read_edit':

            exit;
        }
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT id AS line_id, description, qty, unit_price, subtotal FROM proyekoice_items WHERE proyekoice_id = :id ORDER BY id ASC");
        $stmt->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // Combo Sales Order (untuk field so_id, wajib diisi)
    case 'read_so':
        $sql = "
            SELECT so.id, so.ref_no, so.tx_date, mc.name AS legacy_customer_name
            FROM sales_order so 
            LEFT JOIN m_customer mc ON mc.id = so.customer_id
            WHERE (so.active = true or so.active IS null) 
                and so.id NOT IN (
            	    SELECT distinct i.so_id FROM proyekoice_items t 
            	    left join proyekoices i on i.id=t.proyekoice_id
            	    WHERE t.so_item_id IS NOT NULL
              	)
            ORDER BY so.tx_date DESC
            LIMIT 200
        ";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);

    // ==============================================================
    // Item dari Sales Order terpilih yang BELUM pernah dipakai di proyekoice

    case 'read_so_items':
        $soId = intval($_POST['so_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($soId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => []]);
            exit;
        }
        $sql = "
      SELECT soi.id AS so_item_id, soi.qty_unit as qty, 
       case
                when soi.disc_percent is true then (coalesce(soi.unit_price,0) - (coalesce(soi.unit_price,0) * (coalesce(soi.disc,0) / 100)))
                else (coalesce(soi.unit_price,0) - coalesce(soi.disc,0))
            end::numeric(14,2) as unit_price,
        case
                when soi.disc_percent is true then (coalesce(soi.unit_price,0) - (coalesce(soi.unit_price,0) * (coalesce(soi.disc,0) / 100))) * coalesce(soi.qty_unit,0)
                else (coalesce(soi.unit_price,0) - coalesce(soi.disc,0)) * soi.qty_unit
            end::numeric(14,2) as subtotal,
       i.name AS product_name
            FROM sales_order_item soi
            LEFT JOIN items i  ON i.id = soi.item_id
            WHERE soi.order_id= :so_id
              AND soi.id NOT IN (
                  SELECT so_item_id FROM proyekoice_items WHERE so_item_id IS NOT NULL
              )
            ORDER BY soi.id asc
        ";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(['so_id' => $soId]);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        // Fallback deskripsi: pakai nama produk kalau kolom description kosong
        foreach ($data as &$d) {
            if (empty($d['description'])) $d['description'] = $d['product_name'];
        }
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // Combo Customer (untuk pilih manual kalau perlu override)
    case 'read_customer':
        $sql = "SELECT id, name FROM m_customer WHERE active = true ORDER BY name ASC";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'create':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 2) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        saveInvoice($db, null, $_POST);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'update':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 3) {

            exit;
        }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID proyekoice tidak valid.']);

        $stmtChk = $db->prepare("SELECT status FROM proyekoices WHERE id = :id");

    case 'finalize':

            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }

        if (!$proyekoice) {

        }

        // Kalau sudah final sebelumnya, tidak perlu proses ulang (hindari jurnal dobel)

            exit;

            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Hanya proyekoice berstatus Draft yang boleh dihapus.']);
            exit;
        }

        $db->query("DELETE FROM proyekoice_items WHERE proyekoice_id = {$id}");
        $db->query("DELETE FROM proyekoices WHERE id = {$id}");

        break;

    // ==============================================================
    default:

}

function saveInvoice($db, $id, $post) {
    $soId       = intval($post['so_id'] ?? 0);
    $customerId = intval($post['customer_id'] ?? 0);
    $proyekDate    = trim($post['proyekoice_date'] ?? '');
    $dueDate    = trim($post['due_date'] ?? '') ?: null;
    $itemsJson  = $post['arrItems'] ?? '[]';
    $items      = json_decode($itemsJson, true);

    if ($soId <= 0) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Sales Order wajib dipilih.']);
        return;
    }
    if ($customerId <= 0) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Customer wajib dipilih.']);
        return;
    }
    if (empty($proyekDate)) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Tanggal proyekoice wajib diisi.']);
        return;
    }
    if (!is_array($items) || count($items) < 1) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Invoice minimal harus punya 1 item.']);
        return;
    }

    $validItems = [];
    $totalAmount = 0;
    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $desc = trim($it['description'] ?? '');
        $qty = Str2N($it['qty'] ?? 0);
        $price = Str2N($it['unit_price'] ?? 0);
        $soItemId = !empty($it['so_item_id']) ? intval($it['so_item_id']) : null;
        if (empty($desc) || $qty <= 0) continue;
        $subtotal = $qty * $price;
        $totalAmount += $subtotal;
        $validItems[] = ['description' => $desc, 'qty' => $qty, 'unit_price' => $price, 'subtotal' => $subtotal, 'so_item_id' => $soItemId];
    }
    if (count($validItems) < 1) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Tidak ada item valid (deskripsi & qty wajib diisi).']);
        return;
    }

    $headerData = [
        'so_id'        => $soId,
        'customer_id'  => $customerId,
        'proyekoice_date' => $proyekDate,
        'due_date'     => $dueDate,
        'total_amount' => $totalAmount
    ];

    if ($id === null) {
        $proyekoiceNo = CreateRefNo('proyekoices', 'proyekoice_no', 'INV');
        $headerData['proyekoice_no']  = $proyekoiceNo;
        $headerData['paid_amount'] = 0;
        $headerData['status']      = 'draft';
        $headerData['created_by']  = $_SESSION['user_id'];

        $db->insert('proyekoices', $headerData);

        $stmtId = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM proyekoices WHERE proyekoice_no = :no");
        $stmtId->execute(['no' => $proyekoiceNo]);
        $newId = $stmtId->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['id'] ?? null;

        if ($newId) insertItems($db, $newId, $validItems);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Invoice {$proyekoiceNo} berhasil disimpan."]);
    } else {
        $db->update('proyekoices', $headerData, "id = {$id}");
        $db->query("DELETE FROM proyekoice_items WHERE proyekoice_id = {$id}");
        insertItems($db, $id, $validItems);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Invoice berhasil diperbarui.']);
    }
}

function insertItems($db, $proyekoiceId, $items) {
    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $db->insert('proyekoice_items', [
            'proyekoice_id'  => $proyekoiceId,
            'so_item_id'  => $it['so_item_id'] ?? null,
            'description' => $it['description'],
            'qty'         => $it['qty'],
            'unit_price'  => $it['unit_price'],
            'subtotal'    => $it['subtotal']
        ]);
    }
}

## File: ./php-crud/trialbalanceCRD.php
----------------------------------------
<?php
/*
  Document      : Trial Balance - Report Handler
  Called from   : js/m.trialbalance.js
  Note          : - Laporan read-only.
                  - Saldo dihitung sebagai akumulasi SEMUA transaksi posted/
                    reversed sampai dengan tanggal akhir periode terpilih
                    (bukan cuma mutasi dalam periode itu saja -- trial balance
                    adalah saldo KUMULATIF per titik waktu tertentu).
                  - Saldo ditampilkan di kolom Debit kalau positif untuk akun
                    normal-debit (asset/expense), sebaliknya di kolom Kredit.
                    Kalau saldo "terbalik" (kontra), tetap ditampilkan di
                    kolom lawan supaya total tetap balance secara matematis.
*/
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }

require_once   '../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once   '../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || empty($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Session expired. Silakan login kembali."]);
    exit;
}

$task = $_POST['task'] ?? $_REQUEST['task'] ?? 'read_trial_balance';
$db   = new crud();

switch ($task) {

    // ==============================================================
    case 'read_periods':
        $sql = "SELECT id, period_name, start_date, end_date FROM accounting_periods ORDER BY start_date DESC";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'read_trial_balance':
        $periodId = intval($_POST['period_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($periodId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode wajib dipilih.']);
            exit;
        }

        $stmtP = $db->prepare("SELECT period_name, end_date FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id");
        $stmtP->execute(['id' => $periodId]);
        $period = $stmtP->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$period) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode tidak ditemukan.']);
            exit;
        }
        $asOfDate = $period['end_date'];

        $sql = "
            SELECT c.id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type,
                   COALESCE(SUM(
                       CASE WHEN c.account_type IN ('asset','expense') THEN l.debit - l.credit
                            ELSE l.credit - l.debit END
                   ), 0) AS balance
            FROM chart_of_accounts c
            LEFT JOIN journal_lines l ON l.account_id = c.id
            LEFT JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
                AND j.status IN ('posted', 'reversed')
                AND j.journal_date <= :as_of_date
            WHERE c.is_active = true
            GROUP BY c.id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type
            ORDER BY c.account_code ASC
        ";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(['as_of_date' => $asOfDate]);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $data = [];
        $totalDebit = 0;
        $totalCredit = 0;
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $isDebitNormal = in_array($r['account_type'], ['asset', 'expense']);
            $balance = floatval($r['balance']);

            $debitCol = 0;
            $creditCol = 0;
            if ($isDebitNormal) {
                if ($balance >= 0) { $debitCol = $balance; } else { $creditCol = abs($balance); }
            } else {
                if ($balance >= 0) { $creditCol = $balance; } else { $debitCol = abs($balance); }
            }

            $totalDebit += $debitCol;
            $totalCredit += $creditCol;

            $data[] = [
                'account_code' => $r['account_code'],
                'account_name' => $r['account_name'],
                'account_type' => $r['account_type'],
                'debit'        => $debitCol,
                'credit'       => $creditCol
            ];
        }

        echo json_encode([
            'success'      => true,
            'period_name'  => $period['period_name'],
            'as_of_date'   => $asOfDate,
            'total_debit'  => $totalDebit,
            'total_credit' => $totalCredit,
            'is_balance'   => abs($totalDebit - $totalCredit) < 0.01,
            'totalCount'   => count($data),
            'data'         => $data
        ]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task)]);
}
